questions.question:
A customer wants to understand how data from third-party applications can be reported in a Customer Service Insights dashboard.  
  
You need to advise the customer how to show the data.  
  
What should the customer use?

options.text: lead and opportunity data from Common Data Service
call intelligence data from Common Data Service
Bing web search for data creation data in Common Data Service
data integration data maps with Common Data Service

questions.explanation:
Data integration data maps define how source fields from third-party systems are mapped into Common Data Service so the integrated data can be used for Customer Service Insights reporting. Customer Insights supports ingesting data from multiple sources through configured data connections and transformations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Data sources overview — Dynamics 365 Customer Insights](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-insights/data/data-sources)

questions.question:
A customer wants to understand how data from third-party applications can be reported in a Customer Service Insights dashboard.  
  
You need to advise the customer how to show the data.  
  
What should the customer use?

options.text: You should configure the use of a timeframe filter.
You should configure the use of a priority filter.
You should configure the use of a global filter.
You should configure the use of a visual filter.

questions.explanation:
A visual filter can be configured as an interactive **Cases by Priority** chart. It displays the case counts by priority and lets users select a priority value to filter the dashboard’s case streams accordingly.

**Learn more:** [Customize interactive dashboards that are based on Unified Interface](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-interactive-dashboards-customer-service-hub) · [Manage service cases using interactive dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-dashboard)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the action’s input parameter type as **Option set**.  
  
Does the solution satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
Business process flow Action Steps do not support actions that have an OptionSet (Choice) input or output parameter. Such an action is unavailable for use in the flow and cannot implement the required review flagging.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a business process flow in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/create-business-process-flow)

questions.question:
Solution: For a new action called **Ready for review**, disable the **As a business process flow action step** option.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A custom action must have **As a business process flow action step** enabled to be added and executed as an Action Step in a business process flow. Disabling it prevents the Ready for review action from being used in the case business process flow, so it cannot implement the required review flagging there.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a business process flow in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/create-business-process-flow)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an action that creates a task record assigned to the case reviewer and adds the text `Ready for review` to the case topic.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An action that creates the reviewer’s task and updates the case topic must also be enabled as a business process flow action step and added to the case business process flow. Creating the action by itself does not complete the business process flow configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a business process flow in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/bs-latn-ba/power-automate/create-business-process-flow)

questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to merge cases.  
  
What is the outcome of the merge process?

<Dropdown
  blanks={[{"id":"duplicate_cases","options":["Merged and canceled","Merged and resolved","Merged and deleted"],"answer":"Merged and canceled","label":"Duplicate cases"},{"id":"open_activities","options":["Moved to the merged case","Canceled"],"answer":"Moved to the merged case","label":"Open activities"}]}

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are customizing an Omnichannel for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You need to configure the escalation process to a human agent.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: In the Power Virtual Agent topic, add the Transfer to agent node.
Add a context variable in Power Virtual Agents to escalate the conversation.
Select a context variable in Omnichannel and update the information from Power Virtual Agents.
Add a bot user to the Omnichannel queue.
Set the operating hours to escalate a conversation.

questions.explanation:
A Power Virtual Agents topic must use the Transfer to agent node to hand off the conversation. The bot sets a context variable to signal the escalation and support routing logic, while the bot user must be added to the Omnichannel queue to receive incoming conversations before escalation. Operating hours define availability and do not configure a bot-to-human handoff. Microsoft documents that bots can transfer conversations to service representatives, context variables support routing, and agents must be added to queues to receive conversations.

**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [Manage context variables](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/manage-context-variables)

questions.question:
You work as an administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service environment.  
  
You must configure Twilio SMS for the customer service division.  
  
Which of the following is required for this configuration? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation:
A Twilio SMS channel in Dynamics 365 Customer Service is configured and validated with the Twilio Account SID and Auth Token. The Account ID choice represents the required Twilio account identifier; the Auth Token provides the associated authentication credential.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure an SMS channel for Twilio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-sms-channel-twilio)

questions.question:
You work as an administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service environment.  
  
You must configure Twilio SMS for the customer service division.  
  
Which of the following is required for this configuration? (Choose two.)

options.text: Create one entitlement template that includes the three different terms. Apply the template to the customer, and then remove the terms that do not apply.
Create a new entitlement for each new support offering for the customer, with terms equal to 25 phone calls and 25 emails.
Create a new entitlement for each new support offering for the customer, with terms equal to 50 phone calls and 50 emails.
Create different entitlement templates for each set of terms. Apply the appropriate template to the customer.
Create three entitlement templates with terms for 50 calls and 50 emails. Apply the template to the customers as they sign the support offering.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service entitlements support a case-based total term and channel-specific terms. A 50-case allocation with phone and email channel terms can support all cases through one channel or distribute usage across both channels. This configuration can be created directly for each customer entitlement or preconfigured in entitlement templates for the offerings. Entitlement channels track the support term separately for each channel, while the entitlement total term limits the overall case allocation.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer) · [Use entitlement templates to set up entitlements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-entitlements-templates)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are implementing Dynamics 365 Customer Service Insights.  
  
The product manager wants to view product-sales trends by the following age groups:  
  
- Ages 18 and younger  
- Ages 19–25  
- Ages 26–40  
- Ages 41–55  
- Ages 56 and older  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
What should you define?
questions.explanation:
Segments group customers by demographic, transactional, or behavioral attributes. Age-based customer cohorts are demographic groupings, so defining segments enables sales trends to be analyzed for each specified age range. Measures calculate metrics, while segment members are the profiles that match the defined criteria.

**Learn more:** [Create and manage segments - Dynamics 365 Customer Insights](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-insights/segments) · [Customer Insights quickstart guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-insights/journeys/customer-insights-quickstart-guide)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You manage a Dynamics 365 Customer Service environment and implement cases to manage customer issues. A case-routing rule is configured to route every case to the appropriate queues according to defined criteria.  
  
A customer service representative confirms that cases created by users are not routed automatically. Comparable cases created from inbound emails are automatically routed to queues.  
  
You need to identify the routing issue for user-created cases.  
  
What is the issue?

options.text: Case routing rules do not automatically apply to manually created cases.
The queue for this case is not set up or is inactive.
The routing rule is not set up to handle the defined routing of cases created by phone.
The routing rule to handle cases created by phone is inactive.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, routing rules do not automatically run for cases manually created in the user interface. Such cases must be routed explicitly by using **Save and Route** or **Apply Routing Rule**. Cases generated through inbound-email automatic record creation can have routing applied automatically.

**Learn more:** [Create a case in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-create-a-case) · [Route records manually using unified routing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/routing-trigger)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
Agents give incorrect responses when responding to customer issues.  
  
You need to configure quick replies.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add a macro in Smart assist.
Add a quick reply to a workstream.
Create a new quick reply with the category name as the title.
Create a new tag for each quick reply.

questions.explanation:
Quick replies are predefined messages that representatives use to respond consistently to common customer issues. Associating a quick reply with a workstream makes the relevant replies available to representatives working in that workstream; unassociated quick replies are available to all representatives. [Microsoft Learn: Create quick replies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-quick-replies)

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Learn — Create quick replies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-quick-replies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Customer service agents cannot access the Customer Service historical analytics reports in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You need to grant access to the reports.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Edit the Customer Service Representative security role to provide read-only access to analytics reports.
Create a new model-driven app to expose the reports and provide app access to the Customer Service Representative security role.
Create a new security role and provide read-only access to analytics reports.
Edit the Customer Service Representative Manager security role to provide read-only access to analytics reports.

questions.explanation:
Access to Customer Service historical analytics dashboards is controlled by the Dataverse security role's Read privilege on the Customer Service historical analytics dashboard report entity, `msdyn_dataanalyticsreport_csrmanager`. Granting that read-only access through the existing Customer Service Representative role, or through a new role assigned to the agents, provides access.

**Learn more:** [Configure analytics and insights dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-customer-service-analytics-insights-csh) · [Manage historical analytics reports in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-cs-historical-analytics-csh)

questions.question:
You work as a system administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You have been assigned to create a service-level agreement (SLA) that enables SLA times and statuses to be tracked.  
  
Which of the following types of SLA should you create?
questions.explanation:
Enhanced SLAs create SLA KPI Instance records for tracked KPIs. These records retain SLA status along with warning and failure times, while a standard SLA tracks only the failure time on the case record.\
\
**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas) · [Enhanced service level agreements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/enhanced-service-level-agreements)

questions.question:
You work as a system administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You have been assigned to create a service-level agreement (SLA) that enables SLA times and statuses to be tracked.  
  
Which of the following types of SLA should you create?

options.text: Add an agent permission role to the required users.
Add a viewer permission role to the required users.
Connect Customer Service Insights to a Power BI environment.
Share the connected workspace with the required users.
Connect Customer Service Insights to a Common Data Service environment.

questions.explanation:
Customer Service Insights uses Power BI for its analytics workspace. Required users need Viewer access to consume workspace content with read-only permissions, and the connected workspace must be shared with them so they can access its reports and insights. Power BI workspace access is granted through roles including Viewer, and Viewer provides read-only access; workspace administrators share access by adding users or groups to a workspace role. [Workspaces in Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-new-workspaces), [Give users access to workspaces in Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-give-access-new-workspaces)

**Learn more:** [Workspaces in Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-new-workspaces) · [Give users access to workspaces in Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-give-access-new-workspaces)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. French is the main language for all Knowledge articles. Each Knowledge article generally contains more than 10,000 characters. Problem details appear in the article's closing text.  
  
You enable AI suggestions for article keywords and descriptions. Users report that the feature does not provide effective suggestions.  
  
You need to provide a solution for the users.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create English translations for all Knowledge articles.
Ensure the problem details are in the first 2,200 characters of the article.
Change the Article content data mapping property to Ingested Article URL.
Assign Read privilege for the Keywords Description Suggestion Setting table.

questions.explanation:
AI-generated keyword and description suggestions are based on the first 2,200 characters of the selected article source text. Placing the problem details within that initial portion ensures the model can use them to generate relevant suggestions. French is a supported language for this feature.

**Learn more:** [Configure AI suggestions for article keywords and description](https://learn.microsoft.com/es-es/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-ai-suggested-article-keywords-description)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
Managers report that support representatives can see contact social security numbers when they open contact records.  
  
Support representatives must only be able to confirm that a social security number is stored. They must not be able to view the number.  
  
You need to configure the application to resolve the issue.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Remove the column from the form.
Set up a business rule to hide the column if it contains data.

questions.explanation:
Field-level security restricts read access to a specific secured contact field through a field security profile. Setting the social security number field’s read permission appropriately for support representatives prevents them from viewing its value while allowing access to the contact record.

**Learn more:** [Column-level security - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/field-level-security)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a customer service representative for a company that uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
When customer service representatives locate records that meet specific criteria, they must be able to do the following:  
  
- Open the records in a new tab.  
- Open one record in a new session.  
- Open one record in an existing session on a new tab.  
  
You need to meet these requirements.  
  
Which two actions should you perform? Each correct answer is part of a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Use session templates and application tab templates.

questions.explanation:
Customer Service workspace provides a browser-like, multi-session interface with tabs. Its navigation behavior opens a record selected from Global search in a new session, while records opened from retrieved search results are opened in the focused session; records can also be opened as tabs within that session.

**Learn more:** [Get started with Copilot Service workspace](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/implement/csw-overview)

questions.question:
You are implementing Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
The customer service supervisor wants to revise one of the intraday KPI calculation methods.  
  
You need to update the supervisor dashboard with the new KPI.  
  
Which tool should you use?
questions.explanation:
Intraday Insights report KPIs can be customized in Power BI. Changing a KPI calculation and publishing the updated dashboard therefore requires Power BI Pro.\
\
**Learn more:** [Omnichannel historical analytics customization](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/737924/omnichannel-historical-analytics-customization)

questions.question:
You are implementing Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
The customer service supervisor wants to revise one of the intraday KPI calculation methods.  
  
You need to update the supervisor dashboard with the new KPI.  
  
Which tool should you use?

options.text: Use an existing customer SLA and change the conditions after assigning the SLA to the customer record.
Create a new SLA for each case that does not have a customer SLA.
Go into the SLA configuration and assign it to a customer.
Automatically apply SLAs to records based on business logic.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service can apply SLAs automatically to records through business logic, including workflows, Power Automate flows, or custom plug-ins. SLAs can also be applied manually by selecting an SLA in the record’s SLA field. These methods allow an SLA to be applied when no customer SLA is already available.

**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas)

questions.question:
A company deploys Dynamics 365 Customer Voice.  
  
After deploying an application at the end of a project, users cannot distribute surveys.  
  
You need to assign users the appropriate role so that they can distribute the survey. You must follow the principle of least privilege.  
  
Which role should be assigned to the users?
questions.explanation:
The Survey Sender role provides the minimum required permission to send or distribute Customer Voice surveys through Dynamics 365 applications, satisfying least privilege.\
\
**Learn more:** [Send a Dynamics 365 Customer Voice survey from Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-from-dynamics-365)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to assign a case, currently routed to you in a queue, to another user because you have scheduled time off work.  
  
You share the case.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
Sharing a Dataverse record grants another user access while retaining the current user’s access; it does not assign ownership or route the queued case to that user. A queue item must be assigned or routed to the other user to transfer responsibility.\
\
**Learn more:** [How access to a record is determined](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/how-record-access-determined) · [Use queues to organize, prioritize, and monitor work](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/work-with-queues)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to assign a case, currently routed to you in a queue, to another user because you have scheduled time off work.  
  
You share the case.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?

options.text: Open the case record through the Productivity automation area.
Open the case record through the session area.
Send the KB article through the Productivity automation area.
Send the KB article in chat through the Omnichannel area.

questions.explanation:
Productivity automation macros support opening records and searching the knowledge base, and Productivity tools must be enabled for representatives to use those productivity features. The Omnichannel macro action sends a knowledge-base article link to the active conversation chat; it is specifically intended to be used with the knowledge-base search action.

**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Use Omnichannel connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-omnichannel-action)

You must create the SLAs.  
  
Which three SLAs should you create? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.

options.text: SLA with 24 hours as the failure time and no warning
SLA with 6 hours as the failure time and a one-hour warning
SLA with 6 hours as the failure time and no warning
SLA with one hour as the failure time and no warning
SLA with 24 hours as the failure time and a two-hour warning

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 SLA items independently define failure and optional warning durations. A warning duration triggers the Nearing noncompliance state before the failure deadline; leaving the warning duration empty creates no warning. The required configurations are a six-hour deadline with a one-hour warning, a one-hour deadline with no warning, and a 24-hour deadline with a two-hour warning.

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service, and you work as a customer service representative.  
  
You have been assigned to identify and remove duplicate cases.  
  
You decide to merge cases to accomplish this goal.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation: Merging cases consolidates duplicate case records into one record, eliminating the redundant case from active use while retaining the relevant information in the surviving case.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to configure a queue for telephone-based cases.  
  
Which two possible methods can accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Define an SLA and entitlements and set entitlement values for case numbers.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service routing rules can evaluate case conditions and route a case to a queue. Automatic record creation and update rules can be associated with a queue and can process incoming activity types, including phone calls, to create or update the applicable records. SLAs, entitlements, and status transitions do not provide queue-routing configuration.

**Learn more:** [Automatically create or update records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-update-records) · [Route cases using basic routing rulesets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-rules-automatically-route-cases)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A customer service manager wants to determine how agents describe customers' reasons for calling support. The manager also wants to automate topics.  
  
You need to ensure that the manager's requirements are fulfilled.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Case age for data mapping and automation of topic by using Power Virtual Agents.
Last interaction for data mapping and automation of topic by using a bot.
Last interaction for data mapping and automation of topic by using Power Virtual Agents.
Case title for data mapping and automation of topic by using a bot.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service identifies and presents topics related to the case title, which captures the support reason. A topic identified as suitable for automation can be added to a bot through the Automate to Bot workflow.

**Learn more:** [Conversation Topics dashboard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/oc-conversation-topics-dashboard?azure-portal=true)

questions.question:
You are implementing a help desk system that allows users to submit cases by telephone or email.  
  
You need to ensure that cases are categorized correctly.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create security roles by support function. Assign the security role to users.

questions.explanation:
The subject tree provides the hierarchical subjects used to classify service cases. Modifying it establishes the case categories that users or service representatives can select, independent of whether cases originate by telephone or email.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage subjects in a subject tree](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-manage-subject-tree)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the macro using a productivity automation connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Productivity automation connector automates model-driven-app operations, including opening and updating records and opening a new form to create a record. Because a case is a model-driven-app record, it supports the macro action needed to open a case from an agent-script step.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Use Productivity automation to create macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-productivity-automation)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the macro by using a custom connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Opening a case is supported by Productivity automation macro actions for model-driven-app records. Custom macros are intended to integrate with non-Microsoft webpages and applications, so a custom connector is not required or appropriate for opening a case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the macro by using an Omnichannel connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An Omnichannel connector supports Dynamics 365 Contact Center conversation operations, such as linking or unlinking a record to a conversation. Opening a form to create a case requires a Productivity automation action; therefore, an Omnichannel connector alone does not meet the requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use Omnichannel connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-omnichannel-action) · [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the macro by using a session connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A session connector performs session-related operations, whereas opening records is a Productivity automation capability. Therefore, a macro intended to open a case requires the appropriate Productivity automation action rather than only a session connector.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Use session connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-session-action)

questions.question:
A customer has three cases currently in process and two cases in the current calendar year.  
  
You need to determine the number of cases remaining on the customer's entitlement.  
  
How many cases remain?
questions.explanation:
With a 25-case annual entitlement, the three in-process cases and two cases already counted in the current calendar year use five entitlement cases. The customer therefore has 20 cases remaining. In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, remaining entitlement terms are automatically calculated from the total available cases and decrease when cases are created or resolved, according to the entitlement configuration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
A company is implementing a customized app that will automatically route cases.  
  
You need to identify the correct URL for connecting to the app location in the cloud.  
  
Which URL format should you use?
questions.explanation: Dynamics 365 model-driven apps expose a documented, bookmarkable URL scheme that appends an /Apps/uniquename/ path segment followed by the app's own unique name to the organization's base crm.dynamics.com URL, allowing a user or another system to navigate directly to a specific customized app rather than the generic organization landing page; a bare organization URL or an undifferentiated /apps suffix does not identify which specific app to open, so the uniquename-qualified path is the correct format for connecting to a particular app's location in the cloud.

questions.question:
You are customizing an Omnichannel for Customer Service deployment for a call center.  
  
The call center manager wants to create a new quick response so agents can save time when typing a greeting message.  
  
You need to create a quick response that includes the customer’s full name.  
  
How should you create the quick response?
questions.explanation:
The dynamic chat-text placeholder for the full name of the customer who initiated the conversation is `{FullName{Customer}}`.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create quick replies — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/pt-br/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-quick-replies)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has the following business units:  
  
- Call center  
- Customer service  
- Digital response  
- Escalation  
  
The security roles have not been changed. The customer service business unit is the parent of all the other business units, and every business unit has its own queues.  
  
Customer service cases are routed to the appropriate individuals by using the queues.  
  
You need to ensure that a particular user in the customer service business unit can read every queue in the parent and child business units.  
  
Which security role should you assign to the user?
questions.explanation:
Dataverse Parent: Child Business Unit access lets a user access records in their own business unit and all subordinate business units. The out-of-box Customer service manager role provides the managerial queue access needed to view queues across that hierarchy, whereas a Customer service representative role is intended for individual service work.

**Learn more:** [Security roles and privileges for Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-au/power-platform/admin/security-roles-privileges) · [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work for a power company that uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. The company supplies outdoor smart light bulbs to customers. Each bulb has an IoT sensor with LTE capabilities.  
  
When a light bulb starts to fail, its IoT sensor must create a work order so that a replacement bulb can be sent to the customer.  
  
You implement Connected Customer Service using Azure IoT Central and Power Automate, but work orders are not being generated.  
  
You need to make sure that work orders are generated.  
  
What must you configure for each bulb?
questions.explanation:
Connected Customer Service generates cases or work orders from an incoming Azure IoT Central alert only when the IoT device is associated with a customer account. Without that association, the system does not generate work orders or cases for the device's alerts.

**Learn more:** [Associate devices with customer accounts in Connected Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-central-associate-devices)

questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to automate adding cases to a queue.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use the convert activities functionality with cases
Use the add to queue button on a case
Use the Assign button on a case

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service routing rules automatically evaluate cases against configured conditions and route matching cases to a queue. The Add to Queue command is intended for manually placing an individual case in a queue, while assignment changes the case owner.\
\
**Learn more:** [Route cases using basic routing rulesets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-rules-automatically-route-cases) · [Manage case queues and route cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-case-queues-and-routing)

questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to automate adding cases to a queue.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service automatic record creation and update rules can create cases from incoming email activities. Selecting Email and the queue associated with the target email address causes the rule to process incoming email queue items, while record-creation conditions determine when a case is created. The rule must be activated before it processes matching emails.

**Learn more:** [Automatically create a case from an email in web client](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-case-from-email) · [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the Activity type to **Email**, then select the queue. Configure autoresponse settings.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An automatic record creation and update rule processes incoming email for the selected queue, but a rule item must also define an action to create a Case. Autoresponse settings only send an email after record creation and do not configure the creation of a case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records) · [Automatically create a case from an email in web client](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-case-from-email)

questions.question:
You are developing a Power Virtual Agents chatbot to handle frequent customer inquiries.  
  
A manager reports that some inquiries are not being routed to the correct customer service representatives. You observe that one node is inactive.  
  
You need to identify why the node is inactive.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Topic checker reports errors and warnings in a topic, including node-level issues, and lets the maker navigate directly to the node that contains the problem. This identifies the configuration or validation issue that causes a node to be inactive or unable to function as intended.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage topics - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-topic-management)

questions.question:
You are responsible for creating surveys through Voice of the Customer (VoC).  
  
You want to ensure that clients who currently receive surveys can unsubscribe when they no longer wish to receive them.  
  
You set the **Allow unsubscribe** setting to **Yes**.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation: Enabling **Allow unsubscribe** lets recipients opt out of receiving future Voice of the Customer survey invitations, allowing clients to unsubscribe when they no longer want surveys.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are an administrator for a company that uses Customer Service workspace.  
  
A user who is working on a case needs help from a subject matter expert (SME). The user gives the SME write access to the case.  
  
The user must be able to initiate a chat by using the embedded Teams chat capability.  
  
You need to enable the chat functionality.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. Choose two.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Enable Join chat for the case record.
Disable Join chat for the case record.
Enable the chat channel in the Customer Service admin center.
Enable Connected chats for the contact record.
Enable Connected chats for the case record.

questions.explanation:
Connected chats must be enabled for the Case record type so users can start and associate an embedded Teams chat with a case. Enabling **Join chat** for that record type lets a user with write access to the case, such as the SME, join its existing connected chats. The Customer Service chat channel does not configure embedded Microsoft Teams chat.

**Learn more:** [Enable or disable Teams chat in Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/teams-integration/enable-teams-chat) · [Configure Microsoft Teams chat in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/sv-se/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-chat)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You are configuring advanced similarity rules. You create a similarity rule for cases and add an exact match for the **Modified On** field on the **Match Fields** tab.  
  
You test the rule and find that exact matches do not appear.  
  
You need to identify why the rule is not working.  
  
What are two possible reasons that the rule is not working? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: A Power Automate flow was not created.
The security role is not set to run the similarity rule.
The similarity rule was not published.
The Modified On field is not set to searchable in the customization of the case entity in the solution.

questions.explanation:
An advanced similarity rule must be activated before it can return similar-case results. Fields used for exact matching must also be configured as searchable through the entity’s Quick Find/search customization; otherwise the search mechanism cannot use that field to find exact matches. Microsoft documents activation as the final rule step and requires adding an exact-match field to the entity’s Quick Find columns and publishing the customization.

**Learn more:** [Use advanced similarity rules to view similar case suggestions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/suggest-similar-cases-for-a-case)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are tailoring an Omnichannel for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You configure the handoff process from Power Virtual Agents to Omnichannel for Customer Service. However, customer conversations do not escalate to human agents.  
  
You need to finish the configuration to fix the issue.  
  
Which two features should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A bot must be added to an Omnichannel queue to receive conversations, and context variables can be used by routing rules to direct an escalated conversation to the appropriate queue for a human agent. These configurations enable the bot-to-agent escalation path.

**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [Manage context variables](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/manage-context-variables)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are presenting Power Virtual Agents to executives at a company.  
  
The executives want to understand which features are available out of the box.  
  
You need to describe those features.  
  
Which three features are available? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Monitor bot conversations in real time.
Use bots in post-chat surveys through routing rules.
Display a view of customer cases to users.

questions.explanation:
The integrated bot and customer-service experience supports real-time monitoring of bot conversations, contextual escalation to a live representative, and an Active Conversation/customer-summary workspace that displays relevant case information and recent cases to the representative. Case assignment and post-chat survey routing are separate customer-service configuration capabilities rather than the listed built-in bot features.

**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [View customer information on Active Conversation form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/oc-customer-summary)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A regional healthcare provider is deploying Dynamics 365 Customer Service to manage appointment scheduling across clinics at multiple locations.  
  
Each clinic has its own medical staff and medical equipment. Equipment and staff resource availability differs by location.  
  
The provider needs greater efficiency and accuracy when booking patient appointments with healthcare professionals and equipment.  
  
You need to configure service scheduling to satisfy the operational requirements, taking into account clinic locations and the availability of medical staff, examination rooms, and medical equipment.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Implement a lead scoring model to prioritize patient appointment scheduling.
Define business closures to account for public holidays and nonoperational days.
Configure work hours to reflect individual schedules of healthcare professionals.
Configure the Case management module to track patient appointment histories.

questions.explanation:
Business closures prevent scheduling resources on public holidays and other nonworking days. Work hours define when each resource is available; configuring them for individual healthcare professionals enables appointment scheduling to respect each professional’s schedule. Microsoft’s service scheduling documentation also supports defining work hours for facilities and equipment.

**Learn more:** [Set work hours to define availability (Customer Service app)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/set-work-hours-resource) · [Set when your business is closed (Customer Service app)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/set-when-business-closed-cs-app)

questions.question:
You are a customer service manager who defines an enhanced service-level agreement (SLA).  
  
You need to accurately track the time that customer service representatives spend on cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Pause the SLA when the case is on hold.
Implement workflows on demand for the case entity.

questions.explanation:
Enhanced SLAs can pause and resume their time calculation while a case is on hold. Pausing the SLA excludes the on-hold period from the active SLA duration, so the recorded time reflects the time actively spent handling the case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas?tabs=customerserviceadmincenter) · [Configure service-level agreements in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-service-level-agreements)

questions.question:
You are a customer service manager who defines an enhanced service-level agreement (SLA).  
  
You need to accurately track the time that customer service representatives spend on cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: one workstream and one routing rule
two workstreams and two routing rules per workstream
one workstream and two routing rules
two workstreams and one routing rule per workstream

questions.explanation:
Push work distribution automatically routes work to representatives, whereas Pick distribution requires representatives to explicitly select work from their open work items. Since work distribution mode is set at workstream creation and cannot be changed afterward, separate workstreams are required for high-priority Push work and lower-priority Pick work. With no further routing conditions, one routing rule per workstream is sufficient.

**Learn more:** [Create and manage workstreams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-workstreams)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service system administrator who works with the Customer Service Hub application.  
  
You need to enable entities for service-level agreements (SLAs).  
  
For which entity can you enable SLAs?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service supports enabling enhanced SLAs for the Account entity, along with certain other business and activity entities. SLA KPIs, schedules, holidays, business units, and contracts are not listed as supported entities for SLA enablement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enable entities for service-level agreements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/enable-entities-service-level-agreements)

questions.question:
You have been asked to forward surveys to clients who opened cases during the last 30 days.  
  
You need to ensure that clients without a Dynamics 365 license still receive a summary of the survey results.  
  
Which two of the following file formats can be used to send the summary?
questions.explanation:
A survey summary report can be distributed to recipients without Dynamics 365 access by exporting it to an Excel workbook or rendering it as a PDF and sending the resulting file. Excel workbooks use the `.xlsx` format, and PDF preserves a shareable report layout; executable and plain-text files are not report-distribution formats for this purpose.\
\
**Learn more:** [View a survey response report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/survey-report)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You administer a Dynamics 365 Customer Service system for a computer support company.  
  
Team members must manage cases as follows:  
  
- A case for a new customer follows a different process from one for a returning customer.  
- A case for a returning customer with a contract follows a different process from one for a pay-as-you-go customer.  
- Every case must be researched and resolved.  
- Cases must be handled in a way that is simple to maintain.  
  
You need to make sure that all team members use the same process when handling cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a business process flow that branches.
Create two different forms and a business process flow for each type of customer.
Create a Power Automate flow that branches.
Create two different queues for the different types of customers.

questions.explanation:
A branching business process flow uses conditional logic to direct a case through the appropriate customer-specific path while retaining shared stages for research and resolution. It gives users a consistent, guided case-handling process and is easier to maintain as one process than separate forms and flows.

**Learn more:** [Enhance business process flows with branching](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/customize/enhance-business-process-flows-branching?view=op-9-1) · [Create or customize a business process flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/customize-business-process-flows)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. A company administrator is configuring Copilot for agents.  
  
The company needs reports about agent transactions and their interactions with Copilot.  
  
You need to recommend a feature or component for the administrator to configure.  
  
Which component or feature should you recommend?

options.text: Ask a Question in Copilot in Customer Service
Agent experience data setting in the Copilot Help pane
Make Copilot available to agents setting in the Copilot Help pane

questions.explanation:
The Agent experience data setting in the Copilot Help pane records agents’ interactions with Copilot. That captured interaction data can be downloaded and analyzed to understand usage and create reports, including reports on agent transactions and Copilot interactions.

**Learn more:** [Manage Copilot features in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-copilot-features)

questions.question:
A company has a Customer Service deployment.  
  
The company intends to implement macros.  
  
You need to create and configure a macro.  
  
Which connector should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Omnichannel connector provides actions for Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center macro operations, including linking and unlinking records to conversations. It is the applicable connector for configuring a Customer Service macro.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Use Omnichannel connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-omnichannel-action)

questions.question:
You are creating a translation of an existing Knowledge article in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You need to configure the elements that support the translation.  
  
Which two elements should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. (Choose two.)  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service supports entering translated text for a knowledge article’s keywords and content. Feedback is not a translation field, and the article subject is not listed among the fields to translate.\
\
**Learn more:** [Translate knowledge articles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/translate-ka) · [Work with knowledge articles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/work-knowledge-articles)

You administer Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to set up automatic case creation for emails received from customers who have a support contract.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure service level agreements to be on hold until a call can be made to the customer.
Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the source type to email. Configure the rule to send automatic email responses to customers when records are created.
Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the source type to service activity. Configure the rule to send automatic email responses to customers when records are created.
Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the source type to email. If a valid entitlement exists, configure the rule to create a case.

questions.explanation:
Automatic Record Creation and Update rules can create cases from incoming email. Configuring the rule with **Email** as the source type and requiring a valid entitlement causes a case to be created only when the customer has an active entitlement, which represents the applicable support contract.

**Learn more:** [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses the Dynamics 365 Customer Service hub to manage cases.  
  
Users report that they cannot display a list of coworkers when they type the `@` symbol in a case timeline note.  
  
You need to enable `@` mentions and ensure that users receive notifications when they are mentioned.  
  
Which two places should you use to enable the settings? Each correct answer presents part of the solution. **(Choose two.)**  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
The environment-level **@mention people when in rich text editors to add and notify users** setting is enabled in the Power Platform admin center. In-app notifications must also be enabled in the model-driven app; for this scenario, that app is Customer Service hub. These two settings allow users to select coworkers after entering `@` in a timeline note and notify the mentioned users.

**Learn more:** [Use @mention to collaborate with your team using Notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/use-%40mentions) · [Manage collaboration settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/settings-collaboration)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a macro that uses an Omnichannel connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Macros automate repetitive agent operations, and the Omnichannel connector supports sending a knowledge base article link to the active conversation’s chat window. This enables agents to share knowledge articles with customers while automating the related workflow.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use Omnichannel connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-omnichannel-action) · [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a macro using a session connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Session connector macros automate session-related operations such as retrieving or refreshing tab information, setting tab focus, opening tab templates, and refreshing session context. They do not send knowledge article links to customers. Sending a knowledge article link to a conversation is an Omnichannel connector macro action, so a session connector macro alone does not meet both requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use session connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-session-action) · [Use Omnichannel connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-omnichannel-action)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a macro that uses a productivity connector.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Productivity-connector macro actions automate model-driven app operations such as opening or updating records, resolving cases, and searching the knowledge base. Sending a knowledge article link to a customer conversation is an Omnichannel connector capability, so a macro with only a productivity connector does not meet both requirements.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Use Omnichannel connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-omnichannel-action)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a macro that uses a Power Automate flow connector.  
  
Does the solution satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Flow connector in a Customer Service workspace macro triggers a Power Automate flow, which supports automating repetitive operations. Sharing knowledge articles with customers is a separate knowledge-management capability; a macro with a flow connector alone does not enable it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use flow connectors](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macro-flow-connector) · [Map Unified Service Desk to Customer Service workspace](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/guidance/resources/cs-usd-migration-guide-map-components)

questions.question:
You are responsible for creating surveys through Voice of the Customer (VoC).  
  
You need to ensure that VoC survey responses trigger an escalation in support.  
  
Which action should you take?

options.text: You should make use of the VoC – Process Survey Response workflow.
You should make use of the VoC – Close Survey Activity workflow.
You should make use of the VoC – Convert Response To Feedback Entity workflow.
You should make use of the VoC – Convert Survey Response To Campaign Response workflow.

questions.explanation: The **VoC – Process Survey Response** workflow processes submitted survey responses and can initiate configured follow-up actions, including support escalations based on the response.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A customer service organization intends to implement knowledge management for a custom entity named Root Cause Analysis.  
  
Users must be able to search for, link, and rate knowledge articles. Users must also receive suggested knowledge articles.  
  
You need to configure Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Navigate to the Knowledge Base Management Settings wizard. Then, navigate to Record types and select Root Cause Analysis.
Add a lookup to the article entity.
In Solution Explorer, expand the Root Cause Analysis entity and select Forms. Edit the main form and configure a knowledge base search control.
In Solution Explorer, expand the Root Cause Analysis entity and select Forms. Edit the main form and configure a subgrid for knowledge articles.
In Solution Explorer, select the Root Cause Analysis entity and then select Knowledge management.

questions.explanation:
A custom entity must be enabled and selected as a record type for knowledge management before knowledge features can be used on it. Adding the Knowledge Base Search control to the entity’s main form provides article search and can be configured for automatic suggestions, article-linking actions, and article ratings. A standalone article lookup or subgrid is not necessary for these capabilities.

**Learn more:** [Add the Knowledge Base Search control to Dynamics 365 Customer Service forms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-knowledge-base-search-control-forms)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Omnichannel for Customer Service for a company.  
  
The company wants agents to support customers through both the company portal and its Facebook page.  
  
You need to enable the appropriate channels.  
  
Which two channels should you enable? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Chat is the Omnichannel channel used to embed a live-chat widget in a website or portal. The Facebook channel enables customer conversations initiated through a business’s Facebook page and routes them to service representatives.

**Learn more:** [Introduction to the chat channel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-chat-widget) · [Configure a Facebook channel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-in/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-facebook-channel)

When categorizing cases through queues, cases should be categorized as __Products__.
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service queues can categorize cases based on products or services. Products is therefore an accurate category, and no adjustment is needed.\

**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.explanation:

Management wants to see statistics for the keywords that agents search most frequently when using the knowledge base.

Which two steps should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.

questions.explanation:

You implement Dynamics 365 Customer Service for an organization. Support representatives use the Customer Service workspace.  
  
When representatives open the workspace, they must start working on existing cases in their queues.  
  
Which screen should the representatives use to complete this task?
questions.explanation:
The Customer Service Agent Dashboard is the representative work screen in Customer Service workspace and provides access to the My Active Cases view for opening and working existing case records. Queue-based case work is therefore performed from this dashboard, rather than from analytics or a multisession feature.

**Learn more:** [Merge cases | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-merge-cases) · [Work with cases | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-create-a-case)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service representative.  
  
You need to take the appropriate action while creating new cases to ensure the automated routing rule is applied.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
The **Save and Route** command saves the case and routes it according to the active routing rule set, thereby applying automated case-routing rules.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage case queues and route cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-case-queues-and-routing)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are implementing Omnichannel for Customer Service for a company.  
  
The company has these requirements:  
  
- Initial conversations must be assigned to Microsoft Copilot Studio chatbots.  
- If a conversation requires escalation, it must be assigned to a human agent.  
- The chatbot and human agents must be in the same queue.  
  
You need to finish the implementation to meet these requirements.  
  
How does the chatbot capacity compare with the agents’ capacity?

options.text: The chatbot capacity must be less than the capacity of the agents.
The chatbot capacity must be higher than the capacity of the agents.
The chatbot capacity must be the same as the capacity of the agents.

questions.explanation:
When a queue contains both a Microsoft Copilot Studio chatbot and human agents, the chatbot capacity must be higher than that of every human agent. Because chatbot capacity is not reduced after a work item is assigned, this setting ensures that incoming conversations are picked up by the chatbot first, while escalations can be routed to human agents in the same queue.

**Learn more:** [Best practices for configuring AI agents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-best-practices)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service manager.  
  
You are preparing to configure queues to manage support. After assigning teams to a queue respectively, you must determine the type of queue to create.  
  
You decide to create a Public queue.  
  
Does this action meet your objective?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, public queues allow everyone in the organization to view the queue and its work items. Private queues limit queue and work-item visibility to a small group of queue members, which is appropriate when support work is intended for the assigned teams.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.question:

You are preparing to configure queues to manage support. After assigning teams to a queue respectively, you must determine the type of queue to create.  
  
You decide to create a Public queue.  
  
Does this action meet your objective?

options.text: Set the time zone in each customized schedule.
Allow the system to automatically convert to each user's time zone when a user signs in.
Set the time zone in Dynamics 365 personal options.
Set the time zone to GMT (Coordinated Universal Time) to enable conversion when you sign in.

questions.explanation:
Each customer service schedule includes a Time Zone setting. Configure the appropriate time zone on every customized schedule so that the schedule’s available support hours use the intended local time and applicable daylight-saving adjustments.

**Learn more:** [Create customer service schedule and define the work hours](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-customer-service-schedule-define-work-hours)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are integrating Power Virtual Agents with Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
You create context variables.  
  
You must complete the handoff process to a human agent.  
  
Which three actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: In Power Virtual Agents, enter the Power Virtual Agents Application ID.
In the Power Virtual Agents topic, add the Transfer to Agent node in the End the conversation node.
In the Omnichannel Administration app, add a user as a virtual agent.
In Power Virtual Agents, disable the Teams channel.
In Power Virtual Agents, select Transfer to agent.

questions.explanation:
A Dynamics 365 Customer Service handoff uses a unique application ID for the Power Virtual Agents bot and represents that bot as an application/virtual-agent user in Omnichannel. The topic must be configured to transfer the conversation to an agent. The Teams channel is enabled for the Power Virtual Agents-to-Dynamics 365 Customer Service connection, so disabling it would prevent the required integration.

**Learn more:** [Configure handoff to Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-hand-off-omnichannel) · [Hand off to a live agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/advanced-hand-off)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service manager.  
  
You are preparing to configure queues to manage support. After assigning teams to their respective queues, you must decide which type of queue to create.  
  
You decide to create a Private queue.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
A private queue limits visibility and work on its items to the queue’s members. When a team is added to a private queue, its members become members of that queue, allowing the assigned support teams to manage their designated work. [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are configuring Copilot in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You try to enable the **Ask a Question** feature, but it is unavailable because knowledge sources are missing.  
  
You need to add the missing knowledge sources to enable **Ask a Question**.  
  
Which three knowledge sources should you use? Each correct answer presents a complete solution. *(Choose three.)*  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Copilot can ground customer-service responses in Dynamics 365 knowledge-base articles and connected external knowledge, including trusted website content and SharePoint content. Embedded Teams chat is not a knowledge-source configuration, and response translation changes the language of generated output rather than supplying knowledge.

**Learn more:** [Enable features in Copilot pane](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/copilot-enable-help-pane) · [Enable knowledge sources from Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/contact-center/administer/knowledge-copilot)

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. A client buys a premium support package that permits six support incidents across two years.  
  
You must configure support-entitlement enforcement.  
  
Which three attributes should you configure? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set the Restrict based on entitlement terms value

questions.explanation:
For an incident-based entitlement, Total Term defines the number of support cases allowed, so it is set to six. The end date defines the two-year coverage period. Setting Restrict based on entitlement terms to Yes prevents case creation after the entitlement term is exhausted. Remaining Term is automatically calculated, while an SLA defines service targets rather than enforcing the incident allowance or duration.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A customer service manager requires a combination of case-data analytics and AI insights. The information must include data from the past year.  
  
The customer service manager finds that Customer Service Hub does not show the information.  
  
You need to fix the issue.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer provides part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Use the Customer Service historical analytics report.
Use the Suggestions for knowledge article authors report.

questions.explanation:
Customer Service historical analytics provides business-intelligence analytics and AI insights for support cases, including AI-discovered topics, and retains data for 24 months, which covers the required one-year period. Unified routing must be enabled to provide the associated routing and historical analytics capability in Customer Service Hub.

**Learn more:** [Manage historical analytics reports in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-cs-historical-analytics-csh) · [Customer Service dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-analytics-insights-csh)

You create a canvas app that displays trending results from a Microsoft Copilot Studio chatbot.  
  
The results must be visible on the Dynamics 365 Customer Service workspace home page.  
  
You need to add the survey-results canvas app to the Customer Service workspace.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add an iFRAME component to the main home page form and reference the canvas app name
Add the canvas app to the sitemap
Create a solution in the environment and add the canvas app to the solution
Add the canvas app component to the main home page form and reference the canvas app name

questions.explanation:
A canvas app can be embedded in a model-driven app form by adding the Canvas app component/control to the main form and setting its App Name to the canvas app’s unique name. This places the canvas app on the workspace home page form.

**Learn more:** [Add an embedded canvas app on a model-driven form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embedded-canvas-app-add-classic-designer)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is using Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
Customer Service workspaces must use custom navigation that meets these requirements:  
  
- An application must open as an anchor tab in the application tab panel.  
- Three additional application tabs must open when a session starts.  
- The communication panel’s default mode must be set to Docked.  
  
You need to determine which tool and feature to use to meet all requirements.  
  
Which two tools/features should you use? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: session templates in Customer Service admin center
application tab templates in App Profile Manager
application tab templates in Customer Service admin center
session templates in App Profile Manager

questions.explanation:
Session templates configure the session experience, including the anchor application tab, additional application tabs that open at session start, and the default communication-panel mode. Application tab templates define the applications available for those session tabs. Both are configured in the Customer Service admin center.

**Learn more:** [Manage session templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/session-templates) · [Manage application tab templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/application-tab-templates)

A company has been using Dynamics 365 Customer Service with Omnichannel for over a year.  
  
Over the past three months, the company has had several product recalls. Customer agents must use standardized, legal-department-approved answers when responding to customer questions received through chats, texts, and phone conversations.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Install the Productivity Tools app from App Source.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Productivity Tools provides the agent-script capability. Agent scripts give customer agents guided text instructions and are intended to ensure that only accurate, company-endorsed information is shared, including where legal compliance is important. Macros automate sequential system actions; they do not provide the approved conversational guidance itself.

**Learn more:** [Dynamics 365 Productivity Tools on Microsoft AppSource](https://appsource.microsoft.com/en-us/product/dynamics-crm/mscrm.d365_productivity_tools-preview?flightCodes=d365productivitytoolspreview) · [Guide representatives with scripts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/agent-scripts)
