You are assessing Copilot in Dynamics 365 Customer Service for a company with a new environment. Copilot features are already enabled.  
  
The company needs to use capabilities in company-developed model-driven Power Apps to show summary information about cases. Each app uses the default Customer Service forms.  
  
Users report that the functionality does not work as intended in the custom apps.  
  
You need to resolve the issue.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable the Case summary Copilot Al feature.
Assign the Customer Service Representative security role.
Enable Copilot features for custom apps.
Add the CopilotCaseSummaryControl to the form.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, enabling Copilot features at the environment level enables them for Copilot Service workspace. Customer Service Hub and custom model-driven apps require Copilot to be enabled for each app in Power Apps. Default out-of-box case forms already display the case summary when the feature is enabled; adding the control is required for custom case forms, not the default forms.

**Learn more:** [Manage Copilot features in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-copilot-features) · [Configure Copilot features for custom case forms and custom apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/copilot-powerapps-settings)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. Agents and the inventory department share the app. The inventory department manages the products, while agents have read-only access.  
  
Agents must be able to access products to add them to cases, but they do not need to see products in the sitemap.  
  
You need to prevent agents from viewing products in the sitemap while preserving this ability for the inventory department.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set product privileges to Basic for the agents.
Configure the site map subarea privileges of the product table.
Set product privileges to Local for the agents.
Configure the site map to remove the subarea where the product is displayed.

questions.explanation:
A Site Map subarea can be configured with table privileges that control whether it is displayed for a user. Set the Product subarea to require a privilege that inventory users have, such as Create or Write, rather than Read. Agents retain Product read access for the case lookup but do not meet the subarea-display privilege, whereas inventory users continue to see it.

**Learn more:** [Create a model-driven app site map in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-site-map-app)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
A customer service supervisor must create canvas apps. The environment uses a Microsoft Dataverse database. The supervisor must be able to create new connections and Microsoft Power Automate flows. The supervisor must not have privileges to access data in the environment.  
  
You need to assign a role to the supervisor according to the principle of least privilege.  
  
Which security role should you grant the supervisor?
questions.explanation:
The Environment Maker role allows a user to create environment resources, including canvas apps, connections, and Power Automate flows, but it does not grant privileges to access environment data. This meets the required maker capabilities while preserving least-privilege access.

**Learn more:** [Role-based security roles for Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/database-security) · [Create a blank canvas app from scratch](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/create-blank-app)

questions.question:
You are setting up a single business process flow in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You need to design the business process flow. What should you do?

options.text: Merge peer branches to a single stage when merging branches.
Span the process across 10 unique entities.
Combine multiple conditions in a rule by using both the AND and OR operators.

questions.explanation:
When branches in a business process flow are merged, all peer branches must merge into one single stage; alternatively, all peer branches can end the process. A process is limited to five unique tables and 30 steps per stage, and a branching rule can use either `AND` or `OR`, but not both.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enhance business process flows with branching](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/enhance-business-process-flows-branching)

You are a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service administrator.  
  
Your company offers standard support contracts that include a total of 20 hours of email support. All 20 hours are exclusively for email support. Phone support is available as a premium service in allotments of 10 incidents.  
  
You need to configure an entitlement template for the standard support. What should you configure?

options.text: Set up an entitlement record for each account. Set the value of the Total terms field for an entitlement to 20. Do not configure an entitlement channel.
Set the value of the Total terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the value of the entitlement channel option to Email.

Set up an entitlement record for each account. Set the value of the Total terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the entitlement channel option to Web. Set the value of the Total terms field to 20.

Set the value of the Total terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the entitlement channel option to Email. Set the value of the Total terms field to 0. Add the Phone option. Set the value of the Total Terms field to 10.

questions.explanation:
An entitlement template prepopulates support terms for entitlements. The standard offering requires a 20-hour total term and an Email entitlement channel so that the support allocation is restricted and tracked for email. Phone is a separate premium service and should not be included in this standard template. Microsoft Learn documents that entitlement template channels define entitled support channels and track terms separately for each channel.

**Learn more:** [Use entitlement templates to set up entitlements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-entitlements-templates)

questions.question:
A company implements Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
Which status reason is used for each case status?

<Dropdown
  blanks={[{"id":"active","options":["Merged","On hold","Problem solved"],"answer":"On hold","label":"Active"},{"id":"resolved","options":["On hold","Waiting for details","Information provided"],"answer":"Information provided","label":"Resolved"},{"id":"canceled","options":["Merged","On hold","Researching"],"answer":"Merged","label":"Canceled"}]}
  explanation={"Dynamics 365 Customer Service maps status reasons to case states: On Hold is an Active reason, Information Provided is a Resolved reason, and Merged is a Canceled reason.\
\
**Learn more:** [Define status reason transitions with Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/define-status-reason-transitions) · [Case (Incident) table/entity reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/incident)"}
/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A trucking company uses a custom table called **Leased Truck** in Dynamics 365 Customer Service to record leasing details. The company is implementing Connected Customer Service for Azure IoT Hub to monitor the leased trucks.  
  
You need to configure the custom **Leased Truck** table for IoT integration.  
  
Which two methods accomplish the goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Set the relationship in the Power Platform admin center.
Create a one-to-many relationship from the Leased Truck table to the IoT Alert table.
Call the IoT - Register Custom Entity action to associate a Leased Truck record with an existing IoT device.
Enable connections to the Leased Truck table.

questions.explanation:
Connected Customer Service can IoT-enable a custom Dataverse table either by using Dataverse Connections to associate its records with IoT devices or by calling the **IoT – Register Custom Entity** action. Enabling Connections on the custom table supports the connection-based method, while that action registers the custom entity and associates it with an existing or new IoT device.

**Learn more:** [Extend Connected Customer Service solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-extend-connected-customer-service-solutions)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service with its default settings left unchanged.  
  
You need to locate similar cases in the system by using a default search feature.  
  
You use Quick Find.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
Quick Find performs text matching across configured searchable columns; it is not the similar-case suggestion capability. Similar case suggestions require configured advanced similarity rules and use Relevance search to identify related cases.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use advanced similarity rules to view similar case suggestions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/suggest-similar-cases-for-a-case) · [About quick find queries](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/quick-find)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service administrator.  
  
You have been assigned to ensure that cases are automatically created from emails received from clients who hold a support contract.  
  
You have created an automatic record creation and update rule.  
  
Which two actions should you take **NEXT**?

options.text: You should configure the rule to generate a case if a valid entitlement exists.
You should configure the rule to send automatic email responses to customers when records are created.
You should set the source type to service activity.
You should set the source type to email.

questions.explanation:
Automatic record creation rules that create cases from incoming messages must have the source type set to **Email**. Selecting **Create case if a valid entitlement exists for the customer** limits case creation to customers with an active entitlement, which represents the support-contract requirement.

**Learn more:** [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service administrator configuring a case dashboard.  
  
You need to filter the dashboard so that it displays only escalated cases and cases marked as **Request**.  
  
Which filter should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Global filter supports filtering dashboard data by values from multiple configured case fields, including the escalation status and the case type value of Request. Microsoft Learn specifically identifies Global filtering as the way to show only escalated cases that are marked as Request.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage service cases using interactive dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-dashboard)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has enabled custom context variables on a chat widget.  
  
Users report that context variables are not being populated for new chats.  
  
You need to troubleshoot the issue by querying the event listeners.  
  
Which listener must be running?
questions.explanation:
`setContextProvider` registers the custom-context provider that the live chat widget invokes when a new chat begins. Its returned key-value data populates the custom context variables, so it must be registered after the `lcw:ready` event. `startChat` can instead pass context directly, but it is not the required registered provider for this configuration.

**Learn more:** [Send custom context during live chat](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/develop/send-context-starting-chat) · [setContextProvider (Omnichannel for Customer Service JavaScript API reference)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/develop/reference/methods/setcontextprovider)

questions.question:
You are implementing Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
Agents require real-time recommendations for warranty-related cases.  
  
You need to enable the appropriate productivity tool to meet this requirement.  
  
Which tool should you choose?
questions.explanation:
Smart assist is an intelligent assistant that provides real-time, context-based recommendations to customer service representatives, such as relevant knowledge articles, similar cases, and next-best steps. [Microsoft Learn: View smart assist suggestions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/oc-smart-assist)\
\
**Learn more:** [View smart assist suggestions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/oc-smart-assist) · [Overview of productivity pane](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/csw-productivity-pane)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create a Power Virtual Agents chatbot that includes Power Automate flows. You are not a system administrator.  
  
Users in your organization must collaborate to develop the chatbot.  
  
You try to share the chatbot by adding user email addresses and assigning the Manager, Power Automate User, and Transcript Viewer permissions on the bot. The **Send an email invitation to new users** option is disabled.  
  
Sharing the chatbot fails.  
  
You need to apply the principle of least privilege to share the chatbot with users for collaboration.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of a solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Assign the users the Environment Maker security role.
Ensure that a System Administrator assigns the users the Environment Maker security role.
Enable Send an email invitation to new users and re-share the chatbot.
Configure a custom context variable for the chatbot.

questions.explanation:
Collaborative chatbot authors must have the Environment Maker security role. A non-System Administrator cannot assign that role while sharing, so a System Administrator must assign it. Power Automate flows used by a shared chatbot are not automatically shared; they must be shared separately so collaborators can edit or add flows.

**Learn more:** [Share agents with other users - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/admin-share-bots)

questions.question:
A company needs to standardize the management of web leads and leads generated by its internal and external sales teams.  
  
You need to create an entitlement.  
  
Which entitlement type should you create?
questions.explanation: An omnichannel entitlement is appropriate when lead management must be unified across web-based intake and leads generated by internal and external sales teams. It supports consistent handling across the organization’s channels rather than limiting the entitlement to a single collaboration channel.

questions.question:
A company needs to standardize the management of web leads and leads generated by its internal and external sales teams.  
  
You need to create an entitlement.  
  
Which entitlement type should you create?

options.text: Create work orders to replace IoT-enabled traffic lights when the light bulb fails.
Create cases to update entitlements support terms for IoT devices when customers reach the end of their entitlement term.
Create cases to moderate social media when users leave poor ratings about an IoT sensor.
Create cases to ship new medication when an IoT sensor reports that the temperature of the medication’s packing material has exceeded its usable threshold.
Create work orders to repair IoT-enabled fiber optic connection boxes when a connection cannot be established for a week.

questions.explanation:
Connected Customer Service for Azure IoT Central receives device-anomaly alerts and can create cases or work orders from those alerts. A failed traffic-light bulb and an unavailable fiber connection box are device faults suited to replacement or repair work orders. A temperature threshold breach in medication packing is a device anomaly suited to a proactive case for a replacement shipment. Entitlement renewal and social-media moderation are not actions triggered by IoT device anomalies.

**Learn more:** [Connected Customer Service overview (IoT)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-overview) · [Connected Customer Service for Azure IoT Central overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-azure-overview)

questions.question:
A company deploys Dynamics 365 for Customer Service. You are assigned a case.  
  
You accidentally close the case before you finish your work.  
  
You need to make sure that you can keep working on the case.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Change the status reason to In Progress

questions.explanation:
Reactivating the case returns it to an active state so work can continue. A case that must be reopened retains its case-resolution history; reassignment changes ownership only, cloning creates another record, and an In Progress status reason cannot replace reactivation of a closed case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Resolve, cancel, and reassign cases in Customer Service Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-resolve-cancel-reassign-a-case)

questions.question:
A company has deployed Customer Service.  
  
The company intends to enable AI suggestions for article keywords and descriptions on a custom form.  
  
You add the Keywords and Description Suggestion control to the form.  
  
You need to add a control to the form.  
  
Which control should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Knowledge Suggestion Section is the form control that hosts the AI-generated keyword and description suggestions associated with the Keywords and Description Suggestion control for knowledge articles.\
\
**Learn more:** [knowledgearticle EntityType (Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM)](https://learn.microsoft.com/uk-ua/dynamics365/customer-engagement/web-api/knowledgearticle)

questions.question:
You are deploying the voice channel for Dynamics 365 Contact Center to an existing Microsoft Azure resource.  
  
When you try to link the Azure resource to Dynamics 365 Contact Center, you are prompted to enter Event Grid application details.  
  
You need to determine what to create in Azure for the Event Grid application details.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
The Event Grid connection uses the application (client) ID and tenant (directory) ID of an app registration. Microsoft documentation also states that an owner of the app registration is required to create Event Grid subscriptions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up incoming calls, call recording, and SMS services](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/voice-channel-configure-services)

questions.question: What should managers use to conduct weekly reviews with case representatives?
questions.explanation:
Agent Insights provides managers with representative-level performance metrics and operational insights that support periodic coaching and productivity reviews. Omnichannel historical agent analytics includes KPI filtering by duration and representative, plus drill-down views designed for supervisor coaching scenarios.\
\
**Learn more:** [Agent dashboard in Omnichannel historical analytics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/agent-dashboard)

A company sells and services bicycles and uses Dynamics 365 Sales and Dynamics 365 Customer Service. You create a custom table named **Bicycle**.  
  
A user attempts to create a personal view containing information from the Bicycle table. The user wants to include customer information from the Account table, but the columns are not available.  
  
You need to make the Account columns available to the Bicycles table.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Create a relationship between the Account table and the Bicycles table.
Add the system administrator security role to the user ID of the salesperson.
Create two separate views: one in the Bicycles table and one in the Account table.
Create the personal view from the Account table.
Add the same columns to both the Bicycles table and the Account table.

questions.explanation:
A Dataverse table relationship associates Bicycle records with Account records, enabling Account data to be used as related data in a Bicycle view. A lookup column on Bicycle creates a one-to-many relationship with Account and provides the required record association.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Dataverse table relationships](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-edit-entity-relationships)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You configured a customer service business unit as the parent of a call center, digital response, and escalation business unit. Each of these business units has its own queues. Customer service cases are routed to the appropriate parties through the queues. You have not modified any security roles.  
  
You must ensure that a user in the customer service business unit can read queues in both the parent and child business units.  
  
You assign the Scheduler security role to the user.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
The Scheduler role supports service-scheduling work, such as working with service activities, the schedule board, and facilities or equipment; it does not grant the required Queue Read privilege. To read queue records in the user's business unit and all subordinate business units, Queue Read must be granted at the Parent: Child Business Units (Deep) access level.

**Learn more:** [Manage security roles in service scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/manage-security-roles) · [How role-based security can be used to control access to entities](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/security-dev/how-role-based-security-control-access-entities?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You have been assigned to configure the available working hours for help desk staff. The staff members have differing schedules.  
  
You are preparing to configure individual working hours.  
  
Which two of the following options should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Customer service working-hour schedules are maintained as Customer Service Calendar records in the Service Management area. The All Customer Service Calendars view provides access to the calendar schedules that define support availability and work hours.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create customer service schedule and define work hours](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-customer-service-schedule-define-work-hours)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You are designing a survey to send whenever a case is closed. The survey must dynamically show additional questions in the same survey when a customer selects **Dissatisfied** as a survey response.  
  
You need to configure the survey.  
  
Which feature should you use?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Voice branching rules can show or hide questions based on a respondent’s answer. A rule conditioned on the **Dissatisfied** response can display the additional follow-up questions within the same survey.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a branching rule for a survey | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/create-branching-rule)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You are designing a survey to send whenever a case is closed. The survey must dynamically show additional questions in the same survey when a customer selects **Dissatisfied** as a survey response.  
  
You need to configure the survey.  
  
Which feature should you use?

options.text: Navigate to Cases in the Customer Service Hub app. Open a record, edit the form, and then edit the Status reason field.
Modify the existing solution and the case entity. Edit the status reason and add an additional status reason value.
Create a new solution and add the existing Case entity. Select Status Reason and add a new value.
Modify the existing solution. Add another entity named Status. Then, create a status reason field with additional options.

questions.explanation:
Status Reason is a built-in column on the Case table. A customizer can add a choice by editing that column in a solution containing the Case table; this works whether the solution already contains the entity or is a new solution to which the existing Case entity has been added. Form editing and a separate custom entity do not change the Case Status Reason column.

**Learn more:** [Add status reason, status reason transitions to manage cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-status-reason-transitions-case-management) · [Define status reason transitions with Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/define-status-reason-transitions)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Dynamics 365 Customer Service for an IT helpdesk.  
  
Support agents frequently use Microsoft Teams to chat and collaborate with external customers.  
  
You need to recommend a platform feature that helps the agents.  
  
What should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams recommend collaborators who have resolved similar cases, helping service representatives identify people likely to assist with the active case or support conversation. This Teams collaboration feature is designed to help resolve customer issues more quickly.

**Learn more:** [Collaborate with AI-suggested contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/use-ai-suggested-contacts-teams) · [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration)

questions.question:
Solution: The similarity level of similar cases to the active case.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
AI-suggested contacts in Microsoft Teams are identified from people who resolved similar cases. The similarity level between those cases and the active case is one of the factors used to determine which contacts are suggested.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration)

questions.question:
Solution: The number of similar cases that the suggested contacts resolved.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The number of similar cases a suggested contact has resolved is a factor used by AI-suggested contacts in Microsoft Teams. A higher number can indicate greater experience resolving the issue represented by the active case or conversation.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration)

questions.question:
Solution: The users who are in the Teams channel.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
AI-based contact suggestions in Microsoft Teams identify representatives who resolved similar cases, based on the context of the active case or support conversation. They are not limited to, or selected because of, membership in a Teams channel. [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration)\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration) · [Collaborate with AI-suggested contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/use-ai-suggested-contacts-teams)

questions.question:
Solution: The average amount of time that suggested contacts take to resolve similar cases.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The average time that suggested contacts take to resolve similar cases is a factor used by the AI capability to identify and rank contacts who may help resolve an active case or support conversation. Contacts with less time spent resolving similar cases can indicate greater familiarity with that issue type. [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration)\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure AI suggestions for contacts in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-teams-collaboration)

questions.question:
You work as a system administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service deployment.  
  
You have been assigned to ensure that customer service representatives can manually add service-level agreements (SLAs) to a record.  
  
You activate the SLA.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation:
Activating an SLA makes the SLA usable, but manual application requires representatives to select it in the **SLA** field on the record. That field is not available on entity forms by default, so an administrator or customizer must add it to enable manual selection.\
\
**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas?tabs=customerserviceadmincenter)

questions.question:
You work as a system administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service deployment.  
  
You have been assigned to ensure that customer service representatives can manually add service-level agreements (SLAs) to a record.  
  
You activate the SLA.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?

options.text: Verify Agent2 has profile-based capacity available.
Give Agent2 a high proficiency rating value for a specific HVAC unit.
Give Agent2 a high proficiency rating value for language.
Add a language resource characteristic to the profile of Agent2.
Verify Agent2 is set as a Contact resource type.

questions.explanation:
Skill-based routing matches a conversation’s required language skill and proficiency against the agent’s assigned skills, and assignment also requires available agent capacity. Assigning Agent2 the language resource characteristic, giving that language a sufficiently high proficiency rating, and ensuring available profile-based capacity allow Spanish live chats to be routed to Agent2.

**Learn more:** [Set up skill-based routing in unified routing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-skill-based-routing) · [Set up skills and assign representatives](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/setup-skills-assign-agents)

questions.question:
You need to configure the SMS workstream for the agents.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Modify the work distribution mode and set to Pull.
Add an Agent assigned automatic message to the channel.
Set the work distribution mode to Push.

questions.explanation:
Push work distribution automatically routes SMS conversations to agents. It also supports representative affinity for SMS, which enables reassignment based on prior conversation history and therefore supports continuity for returning customers.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage workstreams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-workstreams)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to resolve the issue with the French-translated article.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Mark the Product associations field complete.
Create a major version of the translated article.

questions.explanation:
Knowledge Search exposes published knowledge content. The parent English article must be published, and the French translation must be published so that the translated version is available in search. Product associations help users find articles related to a product but do not replace publishing.

**Learn more:** [Publish knowledge articles | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/use/publish-ka) · [Translate knowledge articles | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/bs-latn-ba/dynamics365/customer-service/use/translate-ka)

questions.question:
You are a customer service representative who uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to identify and remove duplicate cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure Dynamics 365 AI for Customer Service

questions.explanation:
Merging cases consolidates multiple cases for the same issue into one case, eliminating redundancy. The merged cases are marked as canceled with a merged status, and their related activities, email, and attachments are associated with the remaining case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Merge cases | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-merge-cases)

questions.question:
You are a customer service representative who uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to identify and remove duplicate cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add the CopilotCaseSummaryControl to the form.
Assign the Customer Service Representative security role.
Enable the Case summary Copilot AI feature.
Enable Copilot features for custom apps.

questions.explanation:
Customer Service Copilot capabilities require additional configuration for custom apps even when Copilot features are enabled in the environment. Enable the **Customer Service Copilot Enabled** setting for each required custom app. Adding `CopilotCaseSummaryControl` is for custom case forms, whereas the apps use default Customer Service forms.

**Learn more:** [Configure copilot features for custom case forms and custom apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/copilot-powerapps-settings) · [Manage Copilot features in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-copilot-features)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to assign a case that is currently routed to you in a queue to another user because you have booked time off work.  
  
You release the case.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
Releasing a queue item removes the current user's name from the **Worked By** field and ends that user's assignment; it assigns the item to the queue owner rather than to a specified different user. Assign or route the case to the intended user instead.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use queues to organize, prioritize, and monitor your work](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/work-with-queues)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to assign a case that is currently routed to you in a queue to another user because you have booked time off work.  
  
You release the case.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?

options.text: You should create a system view.
You should create a public view.
You should create a personal view.
You should create a shared view.

questions.explanation:
A personal view lets an individual customer service representative define filters for a case list, such as cases that remain open for one month. Personal views are owned and created by individual users; public and system views are created or configured by app makers. [Understand model-driven app views — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-views)

**Learn more:** [Understand model-driven app views — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-views)

questions.question:
A customer has a Customer Service environment.  
  
The customer uses service scheduling to manage appointments.  
  
You need to add new facilities for service scheduling.  
  
Which security role is needed to add new facilities?
questions.explanation:
The Scheduler security role can create and access Facilities and Equipment in Dynamics 365 Customer Service Service Scheduling, allowing users assigned that role to add facility records.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage security roles in service scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/manage-security-roles)

questions.question: Which of the following statements is **TRUE** when you design a business process flow?

options.text: You can use up to 40 steps for each stage.
Each branch can be no more than 10 levels deep.
You can select an entity relationship when defining a process flow.
You can use a minimum of 30 stages per process, as well as a minimum of 30 steps per stage.

questions.explanation:
A business process flow branch can be no more than 10 levels deep. When defining the flow, a table relationship can also be selected; it must be a 1:N (one-to-many) relationship. A process supports a maximum—not a minimum—of 30 stages and 30 steps per stage.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a business process flow in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/create-business-process-flow)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service administrator.  
  
Your company offers standard support contracts totaling 20 hours of support. All 20 hours are for email support only. Phone support is available as a premium service in allotments of 10 incidents.  
  
You need to configure an entitlement template for standard support.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Set the value of the Total Terms field for an entitlement to 50. Set the entitlement channel option to Email.Set the value of the Total terms value to 20.
Set the value of the Total Terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the value of the entitlement channel option to Email.

Set the value of the Total terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the entitlement channel option to Email. Set the value of the Total terms field to 0.Add the Phone option.Set the value of the Total Terms field to 10.
Set up an entitlement record for each account. Set the value of the Total Terms field to 20. Set the entitlement channel to Web.Set the value of the Total Terms field to 20.

questions.explanation:
An entitlement template’s Total Term defines the amount of support available, and entitlement channels define the permitted support channels. Standard support must therefore have a total term of 20 hours and use the Email channel only; Phone belongs to a separate premium entitlement. Microsoft documents that each entitlement channel can be assigned and tracked separately from the entitlement’s total support term.

**Learn more:** [Set up entitlements quickly with templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-entitlements-templates) · [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
You need to make sure that an appropriate resource can be scheduled for sick appointments.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A Service configuration defines the resources required to perform a service activity. Defining the sick-appointment service with doctor and nurse resources allows scheduling only when the necessary appointment resources are available.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create or edit a service in Service Scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-edit-service-csh)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to satisfy the workspace requirements for case representatives.  
  
Which role should be assigned to case representatives?
questions.explanation:
The Viewer role provides workspace access for viewing without permissions to create workspaces or control workspace access. This satisfies the requirement that case representatives can only view workspaces, while workspace creation and access control remain restricted to escalation managers.\
\
**Learn more:** [User roles - Dynamics 365 Customer Insights](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-insights/data/user-roles)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to satisfy the workspace requirements for case representatives.  
  
Which role should be assigned to case representatives?

options.text: Select the System Management menus and configure them in the settings.
Connect the data through Dynamics 365 Customer Service to Dynamics 365 Customer Service Insights.
Connect the data through Dynamics 365 Customer Service Insights to Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
Install the solution and menu items that will appear in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
Create a new dashboard in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and select the correct information.

questions.explanation:
Customer Service Insights capabilities are configured and viewed within Dynamics 365 Customer Service. A dashboard in Customer Service can be created and populated with the appropriate information to provide the required analytics; a separate Customer Service Insights connection or solution installation is not required.

**Learn more:** [Configure analytics and insights dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-customer-service-analytics-insights-csh)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company extends Dynamics 365 Customer Service by creating a custom table that stores reviews. No other customizations have been made.  
  
The production environment has two Microsoft Entra group teams configured:  
  
- Group 1 has security role 1 assigned, with no read permissions on the review table.  
- Group 2 has security role 2 assigned, which includes read permissions on the review table.  
  
No other security roles are assigned to users.  
  
One member of group 1 needs the ability to read review records.  
  
You need to grant the member the ability to view review records.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add them to an access team as a member.
Change them to the root business unit.
Ask a member of group 2 to share review records with them.

questions.explanation:
Dataverse security roles define table access, and privileges from multiple assigned roles are cumulative. Directly assigning security role 2 grants the individual its read permission for the review table. Access teams and record sharing provide record-specific collaboration rather than the required role-based table access.

**Learn more:** [Assign a security role to a user](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/assign-security-roles) · [Access Teams and Owner Teams for Record Sharing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/use-access-teams-owner-teams-collaborate-share-information)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service administrator. Emails are automatically converted into cases.  
  
Users report that emails are no longer being converted into cases.  
  
What could be the cause?

options.text: The Dynamics Flow process is not running.
Your user ID does not have permission to run the process effectively.
The workflow process has been deactivated.
The solution has not been published.

questions.explanation:
Automatic record-creation rules apply to incoming emails only when the rule is active, and activating the rule creates an associated workflow. A deactivated workflow prevents the automatic email-to-case process from running.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service system administrator who must create service-level agreements (SLAs) that meet company requirements.  
  
What SLA types should you use? Each SLA type may be used once, more than once, or not at all.

<DragDrop
  items={["Standard","Enhanced","KPIs"]}
  slots={[{"answer":"Enhanced","id":"track_status_times","label":"Track the status and times of an SLA"},{"answer":"Enhanced","id":"add_success_actions","label":"Add success actions to an SLA"}]}
  reuse={true}
  explanation={"Enhanced SLAs create SLA KPI instances that expose status, failure time, and warning time, and they support success actions. KPIs are measures used by SLAs rather than an SLA type to assign.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enhanced service level agreements (SLAs)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/admin/enhanced-service-level-agreements?view=op-9-1) · [Apply SLAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas)"}
/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a help desk representative for an organization that uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
Users need to search the system for similar cases. None of the out-of-the-box settings have been modified.  
  
You must determine which search features are available by default.  
  
Which two search features are available? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Standard Quick Find and Advanced Find are built-in search capabilities. Quick Find is enabled for table grids, and Advanced Find is available for creating criteria-based queries. Full-text Quick Find is an administrator-enabled, on-premises indexing option rather than the default Quick Find behavior.

**Learn more:** [Compare search options in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/search) · [Configure Quick Find options in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (on-premises)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/admin/configure-quick-find?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A midsize service company serves clients with a range of service requirements. The company intends to implement URS to schedule its service technicians.  
  
The company requires a solution that uses custom tables.  
  
You need to recommend a URS implementation process that enables a table for scheduling.  
  
What should you recommend?

options.text: Use the Resource Scheduling application to configure table settings.
Configure the environment settings in the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.
Update the solution import settings when importing the solution into the production environment.
Update the Scheduling Services in the Customer Service Hub application.

questions.explanation:
Custom tables are enabled for Universal Resource Scheduling in the Resource Scheduling application. Its Settings > Administration area includes **Enable Resource Scheduling for Entities**, where an administrator selects the custom table, creates or selects the booking and requirement relationships, and publishes the customization.

**Learn more:** [Enable an entity for scheduling in Universal Resource Scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/common-scheduler/schedule-new-entity)

questions.question:
You are a customer service manager for a company that uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to configure queues to manage support, assigning a team to each queue.  
  
What type of queue should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A private queue is used for a defined group of members, such as a support team, to view and work its queue items. Dynamics 365 team queues are private and are visible to the team owner and team members.\
\
**Learn more:** [Queue entities (Developer Guide for Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/queue-entities?view=op-9-1) · [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.question:
You are a customer service manager for a company that uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to configure queues to manage support, assigning a team to each queue.  
  
What type of queue should you configure?

options.text: You should create a new case based on the one that was accidentally closed.
You should reactivate the closed case.
You should reallocate the closed case
You should create a new case and merge it with the closed case.

questions.explanation:
Reactivating the closed case returns the existing case to an active state so work can continue while retaining its original record and history. Microsoft’s Customer Service documentation recognizes that cases may need to be reopened and provides case-resolution history for that purpose.

**Learn more:** [Resolve, cancel, and reassign cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-resolve-cancel-reassign-a-case)

questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You need to create business process flows.  
  
Which three entities can you use? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 business process flows can be used with supported system entities, including Case, Letter, and Social Activity. Goal and Rollup Query are not supported entities for business process flows.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use business process flows in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/customize/business-process-flows-overview?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are assisting a company with implementing Power Virtual Agents with Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
The company has a chatbot that escalates to a manager when a customer requests escalation from the chatbot.  
  
You need to configure a prerequisite before implementing the chatbot.  
  
Which prerequisite should you configure?

options.text: Configure context variables for a chatbot.
Create one chatbot in one queue with a human having a higher capacity over the chatbot.
Create one chatbot in one queue with the chatbot having the highest capacity over human capacity.
Configure a Microsoft Teams support channel for the chatbot.
Configure an SMS channel for a chatbot.

questions.explanation:
In a queue containing both a chatbot and human agents, the chatbot must be assigned a capacity higher than every human agent so that incoming conversations are routed to the chatbot first. The chatbot can then hand off an escalation to a human manager.

**Learn more:** [Best practices for configuring AI agents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-best-practices)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
The company needs the **Ask a Question** capabilities in Copilot for Dynamics 365 Customer Service. The company has many support articles, and agents must be prevented from accessing some of them.  
  
You need to ensure that, when asking Copilot a question, agents can open only the articles relevant to them.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Automated filters apply knowledge-base filtering rules automatically for the record an agent is working on, so Copilot uses only the relevant articles for Ask a Question. They can operate in the background, preventing agents from viewing or changing the filtering criteria.

**Learn more:** [Enable features in Copilot pane — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/copilot-enable-help-pane) · [Use Copilot filters — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/use-copilot-filters)

A company is using Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
The company wants to configure Power Virtual Agents within Omnichannel so that customers receive automatic responses when they begin a chat session.  
  
You need to configure the prerequisites for Power Virtual Agents.  
  
Which three technologies should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A Power Virtual Agents chatbot provides the automated customer responses. It must be added to an Omnichannel workstream, which defines the handling and routing context for the conversation, and customers access the chat through a configured chat widget. Microsoft documentation describes creating an agent, adding it to a workstream, and configuring a chat widget for customer interaction.

**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [Configure a chat widget in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-chat-widget)

questions.question:
You are using Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
You need to ensure that customers request support through email, phone, or web, according to the contracts they have signed with your company.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create an entity for each channel and configure the relationship with the entitlement.

questions.explanation:
Entitlement channels define the support channels through which a customer is entitled to contact the organization and can track support terms separately for each channel. This allows contract-based restrictions for channels such as email, phone, and web.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
Solution: Go to the resolved case and select **Send Survey**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Selecting **Send Survey** on a case sends a survey only when a user manually performs that action. Automatically emailing the case contact when a case is resolved requires the Customer Voice/Power Automate automation for “Send a survey when a case is resolved in Dynamics 365,” which also attaches the submitted response to the case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Integrate Dynamics 365 Customer Voice with Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-voice/integrate-cv-cs) · [Send a survey by using Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-flow)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a cloud flow. Use the **Create an invitation** action. Then resolve the case.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
The Customer Voice **Create an invitation** action creates a personalized invitation link but does not distribute it by email. A separate email-sending action is required to send that link. To make responses visible on the case, the invitation and response must also be associated with the Case record through the **Regarding** field.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a survey invitation by using Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/create-survey-invite) · [Send a survey by using Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-flow)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a cloud flow that uses the **Send email (V2)** action and includes a link to a website containing the embedded survey.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An embedded-survey link sent through a standard email action does not create a Customer Voice survey invitation whose **Regarding** value is the Case record. To make responses visible against the resolved case, the flow must send the Customer Voice survey and associate its invitation and response with that case; Microsoft’s case-resolution survey template performs this association.\
\
**Learn more:** [Send a survey by using Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-flow) · [Integrate Dynamics 365 Customer Voice with Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-voice/integrate-cv-cs)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a cloud flow. Use the **Send a survey** action. Resolve the case.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Power Automate cloud flow can send a Dynamics 365 Customer Voice survey when a case is resolved. The **Send a survey** action creates the survey invitation and can associate both the invitation and response with the case by using the case as the Regarding record, so the submitted response is visible on the case timeline.\
\
**Learn more:** [Send a survey by using Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-flow) · [Integrate Dynamics 365 Customer Voice with Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/integrate-cv-cs)

questions.question:
You are setting up Microsoft Teams chat integration for a custom model-driven application.  
  
Users report that they cannot use the chat feature in the app.  
  
You determine that the capability has not yet been enabled.  
  
You need to enable this functionality.  
  
Which area should you access to enable it?

options.text: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service admin center

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Teams chat for a custom model-driven app is enabled at the environment level in the Power Platform admin center. Navigate to the environment’s settings, then Integration > Teams integration settings, and turn on Microsoft Teams chats inside Dynamics 365.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure Microsoft Teams chat in Dynamics 365 Sales](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/sales/teams-integration/enable-teams-chat)

questions.question:
You are setting up Microsoft Teams chat integration for a custom model-driven application.  
  
Users report that they cannot use the chat feature in the app.  
  
You determine that the capability has not yet been enabled.  
  
You need to enable this functionality.  
  
Which area should you access to enable it?

options.text: Navigate to the Customer Service admin center.

questions.explanation:
Agent scripts provide representatives with real-time text guidance and ensure that only accurate, company-endorsed information is shared, including for legal-compliance needs. The productivity pane is the workspace area that displays scripts to representatives, so it must be enabled for the agents who handle the conversations.

**Learn more:** [Guide representatives with scripts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/agent-scripts) · [Productivity pane overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/productivity-pane)

questions.question:
You need to set up the Power Virtual Agents chatbot.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Embed a chat widget in the portal.
Add a chatbot to the workstream.

questions.explanation:
A chatbot must be added to the appropriate messaging workstream so that incoming conversations are routed to it and it can hand off a conversation to a live representative when escalation is needed. Microsoft’s current documentation refers to Power Virtual Agents chatbots as Copilot agents and directs administrators to select **Add bot** in the workstream’s Bot area.\
\
**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [Create and manage workstreams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-workstreams)

questions.question:
You need to set up the chat channel.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Persistent chat lets customers begin a conversation outside operating hours and resume it across later sessions. If no representative is available, the conversation remains open and messages are received when representatives are available.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure persistent chat | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/persistent-chat)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to set up the chatbot.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add the chatbot to an existing human agent queue.
Configure context variables for the chatbot.
Enable a Power Virtual Agents chatbot to end conversations.
Create a chatbot queue and a human agent queue.
Enable AI suggestions with the chatbot.

questions.explanation:
A chatbot must be added to an Omnichannel queue so it can receive conversations. Context variables provide the routing data used when the chatbot escalates a conversation, allowing Omnichannel to route the work item to the appropriate human-agent queue while preserving relevant conversation context.

**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [Manage context variables](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/manage-context-variables)

questions.question:
You need to set up the portal for external customers.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add table permissions to a web role.
Ensure the model-driven app is shared with all customers.
Ensure all customers have an Active Directory account.
Ensure all contact records are configured for portal use.

questions.explanation:
Power Pages restricts access to Dataverse records by default. Table permissions must be associated with a web role to grant portal users the necessary, least-privilege access to records such as their cases and case-status data.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set table permissions in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/table-permissions)

questions.question:
You need to set up the portal for external customers.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable AI suggestions with the chatbot.
Enable a Microsoft Copilot Studio chatbot to end conversations.
Add the chatbot to an existing human agent queue.
Configure context variables for the chatbot.
Create a chatbot queue and a human agent queue.

questions.explanation:
A Copilot Studio chatbot must be added to a queue that contains human agents so an escalated conversation can be routed from the bot to a live representative. The chatbot must also be enabled to end conversations so its interaction can conclude and hand off appropriately. Microsoft documents adding an agent to a queue and configuring an end-of-conversation capability for customer-service integrations.

**Learn more:** [Integrate a Copilot agent in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-virtual-agent) · [Configure handoff to Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-hand-off-omnichannel)

questions.question:
You need to configure the Dynamics 365 Customer Service workspace to fulfill the representatives’ needs.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Macros in agent scripts automate repeatable representative tasks. They can open application tab templates in the workspace and open predefined email templates, allowing representatives to work with assigned records in tabs and compose standardized emails efficiently. Real-time negative-sentiment alerts for supervisors are provided by the separately configured sentiment-analysis feature.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Enable real-time customer sentiment with sentiment analysis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/enable-sentiment-analysis)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to involve managers when necessary.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Sentiment analysis evaluates customer sentiment during conversations and can notify supervisors when sentiment falls to a configured negative threshold. This supports manager involvement when a customer expresses negative feedback in a live session.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enable real-time customer sentiment with sentiment analysis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/enable-sentiment-analysis)

questions.question:
You need to configure the Microsoft Copilot Studio chatbot.  
  
What should you set up?

options.text: Embed a chat widget in the portal.
Add a chatbot to the workstream.

questions.explanation:
A Copilot Studio chatbot must be added to a Dynamics 365 Customer Service messaging workstream to receive routed conversations and support bot-to-agent handoff. A workstream is the routing container for messaging conversations, and Microsoft’s configuration guidance specifies adding the bot in the workstream’s Bot area.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage workstreams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-workstreams) · [Configure handoff to Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configuration-hand-off-omnichannel)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to alert managers about dissatisfied patients.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set a routing rule for escalations.
Change the value of the Monitor real-time customer sentiment option to Yes.

questions.explanation:
Real-time sentiment analysis supports supervisor notifications when a customer’s sentiment falls to a configured negative threshold. Enabling **Monitor real-time customer sentiment** activates the capability required for those notifications.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enable real-time customer sentiment with sentiment analysis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/enable-sentiment-analysis)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You use Dynamics 365 Customer Service to manage cases.  
  
You need to create a service-level agreement (SLA) that issues a warning when two KPI values meet a specified condition: First response and Resolve by.  
  
Which two SLA-detail types should you use? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
SLA KPIs identify the performance measure tracked by an SLA item. First response and Resolve by are separate KPI measures, so each requires its own SLA item/detail: one for the response KPI and one for the resolve KPI. Warning behavior is configured on those SLA items through the warning duration and related actions.

**Learn more:** [Configure service-level agreements in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-service-level-agreements) · [Overview of service-level agreements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/overview-service-level-agreements)

questions.question:
You configure the Case Management Agent for a company. The company had previously disabled every AI feature in the environment.  
  
Users report that the agent does not automatically update cases using information from conversations.  
  
You need to fix the issue.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Enable the Customer Knowledge Management Agent.

questions.explanation:
Autonomous case updates by Case Management Agent depend on AI form fill assistance being enabled in the environment. Enabling that feature restores the prerequisite for the agent to predict and update case fields from conversation information.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up Case Management Agent to create and update cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-autonomous-case-agents)

options.text: You should configure a business process flow.

questions.explanation:
Entitlement channels define the support channels through which a customer can obtain assistance and track the entitlement terms allocated to each channel separately, such as phone or email support. questions.question:
A company has deployed Customer Service.  
  
The company plans to implement macros.  
  
You need to create and configure a macro.  
  
Which connector should be used?
questions.explanation:
The Session connector provides the session-related actions used in Dynamics 365 Customer Service macros, including tab and session-context operations. Microsoft’s macro configuration guidance identifies the Session connector for creating macros.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros)

questions.question:
A company is building a Power Virtual Agents chatbot that integrates with Dynamics 365 Omnichannel for Customer Service. The company has offices in Africa and South America.  
  
You need to deploy Power Virtual Agents (PVAs) to every supported country/region.  
  
To which three geographies should you deploy the PVAs? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation: For this Power Virtual Agents availability set, supported deployment geographies are the United States, Asia, and Europe. Africa and South America are not supported PVA deployment geographies, so office locations in those areas do not create additional supported deployment targets.

You need to deploy Power Virtual Agents (PVAs) to every supported country/region.  
  
To which three geographies should you deploy the PVAs? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A card form defines the compact activity information displayed in a timeline. The timeline configuration on each host form can use a different Feedback card form, so the case timeline can display column A while the account timeline displays column B.

**Learn more:** [Set up the timeline control - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/set-up-timeline-control) · [Types of model-driven app forms in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/types-forms)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service with the default settings unchanged.  
  
You want to locate similar cases in the system by using a default search feature.  
  
You use Full-text Quick Find.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
Similar-case suggestions in Dynamics 365 Customer Service are generated through configured advanced similarity rules and the relevance-search mechanism. Full-text Quick Find alone does not provide the similar-case suggestion capability.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use advanced similarity rules to view similar case suggestions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/suggest-similar-cases-for-a-case)

questions.question:
You need to evaluate the underlined segment to determine whether it is accurate.  
  
To ensure that a survey displays follow-up questions based on responses to the preceding question, the *Response routing* feature should be used in the survey.
questions.explanation:
Response routing supports conditional survey behavior based on an earlier response, including client-side actions that show or hide follow-up questions. The statement is therefore accurate.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a branching rule for a survey](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/create-branching-rule)

questions.question:
A company implements Customer Service.  
  
You enable historical analytics for Customer Service.  
  
You need to determine which feature is automatically enabled when Customer Service historical analytics is enabled.  
  
Which feature should you identify?
questions.explanation:
Enabling Customer Service historical analytics also enables AI-discovered topics from cases with the default configuration. This capability groups related cases into topics, which corresponds to AI topic clustering.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage historical analytics reports in Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-cs-historical-analytics-csh)

questions.question:
A company implements Customer Service.  
  
You enable historical analytics for Customer Service.  
  
You need to determine which feature is automatically enabled when Customer Service historical analytics is enabled.  
  
Which feature should you identify?

options.text: In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, enter the portal URL that will be used to create external (public facing) portal links for knowledge articles in the Knowledge Solution field.
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, under Knowledge Source, in the Knowledge Solution field, enable sharing the knowledge article as a link in the email sent to the customer.
In the Knowledge Articles Feedback section, set Enable users to provide feedback on knowledge articles from search control to Yes.
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, ensure that the representative closing the case attaches the knowledge article to the record.

questions.explanation:
A public portal URL format is required to generate external knowledge-article links. Knowledge settings must also enable sharing a knowledge article as a link in an email so customers can receive and open that public article URL. Feedback configuration is unrelated to sharing, and associating an article with a case alone does not enable external email-link sharing.

**Learn more:** [Configure knowledge management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-knowledge-management-embedded-knowledge-search) · [Add the Knowledge Base Search control to Dynamics 365 Customer Service forms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-knowledge-base-search-control-forms)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as an administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You have received knowledge-base articles created by a reviewer.  
  
Which of the following actions should be taken for approved articles?

options.text: The approved article must be sent to the Manager.
The approved article must be published.
The approved article must be sent back for final edits.
The approved article’s status must be changed to Active.

questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, approval confirms that a knowledge article has been reviewed and is ready for publication. The default knowledge-article process publishes approved articles so they can become available for search and use; articles needing edits are rejected instead. [Review knowledge articles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/use/review-ka)
