Customer service representatives cannot manually add service-level agreements (SLAs) to a record.  
  
You need to enable on-demand SLAs.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure the scope of the workflow
Request an administrator to add the SLA field to the entity form

questions.explanation:
Manual application of an SLA is performed by selecting an SLA in the record’s SLA field. Because that field is not available on entity forms by default, a system administrator must add it to the applicable entity form before representatives can apply SLAs on demand.\
\
**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas)

questions.question:
Customer service representatives cannot manually add service-level agreements (SLAs) to a record.  
  
You need to enable on-demand SLAs.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set the closure preference setting to Don’t allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed. In Settings, navigate to Customizations. On the case entity, update the Incident-Incident Resolution case relationship field mapping to include the fields.

Validate that customer and case title fields have not been removed as fields that child cases inherit from parent cases. Add product and case type fields to the list. Set the closure preference setting to Don’t allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed.

Validate that customer and case title fields have not been removed as fields that child cases inherit from parent cases. Add product and case-type fields to the list. The closure preference setting does not need to be changed. This is default behavior.

questions.explanation:
Parent-child case settings require Case Title and Customer as inherited attributes, so they should be confirmed as selected; Product and Case Type must be added to the selected inherited attributes. The closure preference **Don’t allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed** prevents a parent case from being closed while any child case is active.

**Learn more:** [Define parent and child case settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-settings-parent-child-cases)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You administer a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service environment.  
  
A customer's entitlement expired last month. The customer must renew the entitlement using the same parameters as the expired entitlement.  
  
You need to create the customer's entitlement.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a new template with the dates and terms. Activate the template.
Delete the old entitlement. Create a new entitlement template.
Add the new end date to the current entitlement and set new terms. Activate the entitlement.
Make a copy of the old entitlement. Activate the copy.
In the old entitlement, zero out the remaining terms and the total terms. Activate the entitlement.

questions.explanation:
Renewing a canceled or expired entitlement creates a new entitlement while retaining the original expired record. The new entitlement copies the old entitlement’s other field values, allowing the same parameters to be reused; it can then be activated for the customer.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a customer service schedule administrator.  
  
A customer has a custom entity that needs its own schedule board.  
  
You need to create the schedule board. You configure the custom entity in the Resource Scheduling parameters.  
  
What should you do next?

options.text: Add a new resource requirement. Add a new view for the custom entity.
Change the default entity name to the custom name. Create a new schedule board for the custom entity.
Disable the schedule board. Configure Resource Scheduling Optimization.
Configure the booking metadata. Create a new schedule board for the custom entity.

questions.explanation:
A custom entity enabled for Universal Resource Scheduling requires booking setup metadata to define its scheduling relationships and booking behavior. After that metadata is configured, a separate schedule board can be created and configured for the custom entity.

**Learn more:** [Enable an entity for scheduling in Universal Resource Scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/common-scheduler/schedule-new-entity) · [Overview of Universal Resource Scheduling in Dynamics 365](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/common-scheduler/schedule-anything-with-universal-resource-scheduling)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a system administrator for Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
All child cases must inherit the product, customer name, case title, and case type from their parent case. Parent cases must not be closed until every child case is closed.  
  
You need to configure cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Validate that customer and case title fields have not been removed as fields that child cases inherit from parent cases. Add product and case-type fields to the list. Set the closure preference setting to Don't allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed.

On the case entity, update the Parent case-Child case 1:N relationship field mapping to include the fields. Create a business rule on the case entity to prevent the parent from closing if it has one or more open child cases.

Validate that customer and case title fields have not been removed as fields that child cases inherit from the parent cases. Add product and case-type fields to the list. The closure preference setting does not need to be changed. This is default behavior.

questions.explanation:
Parent-child case settings define which case attributes a child inherits. Customer and Case Title are mandatory inherited attributes; Product and Case Type must also be selected. To block closure of a parent case while any child case is open, select the closure preference **Don't allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed**.

**Learn more:** [Define settings for parent and child cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-settings-parent-child-cases)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service administrator.  
  
You need to deactivate entitlements.  
  
When should entitlements be deactivated? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: A customer's entitlement has ended and no more support is desired.
A customer renews an entitlement for 100 more hours or one year.
A customer calls and wants to know how many hours of support remain.
The customer must change remaining support hours from all email support to one-half email support and one-half phone support.
You need to add notes to the customer's entitlement.

questions.explanation:
Active Dynamics 365 Customer Service entitlements cannot be edited. Deactivating the entitlement allows its support terms to be changed, including reallocating remaining support between email and phone channels. An entitlement that is no longer valid is canceled instead, and renewal creates a new entitlement from a canceled or expired one.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

options.text: Update the rules cloud flow to create an email in Dynamics 365.
Configure an additional action after condition matching.
Update the rules cloud flow to send an email.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service supports an additional action after a rule condition matches that automatically replies to the email. Enabling that action allows selection of a predefined email template, so the notification is handled by the existing rule configuration without custom flow development.

**Learn more:** [Automatically create or update records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-update-records)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You administer a Dynamics 365 Customer Service environment. The company handles thousands of cases each day. Some cases are parent cases, although most are child cases.  
  
When users create a child case, they report having to re-enter information from fields on the parent case.  
  
You need to make sure that, when a new child case is created within the context of a parent case, values in specific parent-case fields are passed to the corresponding child-case fields.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a many-to-many relationship and update the data mapping.
Update the attributes that the child case will inherit from the parent case.

questions.explanation: Dynamics 365 Customer Service allows specific case attributes to be configured for inheritance from a parent case. Configuring the attributes that child cases inherit automatically carries the selected parent-case values into a newly created child case.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are an IT administrator for a hospital network.  
  
Heart-monitoring devices are deployed at multiple locations. The devices are managed in Dynamics 365 Connected Customer Service.  
  
New logic must be automatically deployed to particular classes of heart-monitoring device.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
Which two components should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Azure IoT Edge runs logic as modules on edge devices and supports automatic deployments to targeted groups of devices, such as classes identified through device-twin tags. Azure IoT Hub provides the device-management service that targets devices and communicates deployment configurations; it is also the IoT service used by Connected Customer Service to manage registered devices and send commands.

**Learn more:** [Automatic deployment for device groups - Azure IoT Edge](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/iot-edge/module-deployment-monitoring) · [Connected Customer Service overview (IoT)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-overview)

A company has an SLA requiring a callback from the call center within three business days.  
  
The call center’s normal hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Eastern time.  
  
The call center is closed on New Year’s Day and the day following New Year’s Day. This year, New Year’s Day falls on a Thursday.  
  
The company calls for support at 8:00 a.m. on the Tuesday before New Year’s Day.  
  
Determine the call center’s SLA deadline.  
  
When will the call center miss its SLA?

options.text: The Monday after New Year's Day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time
The Friday after New Year's Day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time
The Tuesday after New Year's Day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time
The Saturday after New Year's Day at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time

questions.explanation: Wednesday is the first business day after the support call. New Year’s Day Thursday and the following Friday are closed, while Saturday and Sunday are not regular business days. Monday is the second business day and Tuesday is the third, making 8:00 a.m. Eastern time on that Tuesday the SLA deadline.

questions.question:
You must assign the minimum required security roles to a bot for the customer service supervisor.  
  
Which security roles should you use?

options.text: Omnichannel agent and customer service representative
Omnichannel supervisor and customer service manager
Omnichannel supervisor and customer service representative

questions.explanation:
The Omnichannel supervisor role grants supervisor capabilities in Omnichannel for Customer Service. The Customer Service Representative role is additionally required to work with the Case entity. Together, these roles provide the required supervisor and case-access permissions without assigning the representative-focused Omnichannel agent role.\
\
**Learn more:** [Assign roles and enable users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-au/dynamics365/customer-service/implement/add-users-assign-roles)

questions.question:
You must configure the SMS workstream.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: the work distribution mode set to push
the work distribution mode set to pull

questions.explanation:
Push work-distribution mode automatically routes an SMS work item to an agent using a notification. Pull/Pick mode instead requires an agent to explicitly select the work item, so it would not resolve the requirement for automatic conversation assignment.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage workstreams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-workstreams)

questions.question:
You need to implement a solution that provides the technician's utilization.  
  
Which solution should you use?

options.text: Use default schedule board with filters.

questions.explanation:
Field Service calculates resource utilization as booked time relative to working hours and displays it on the schedule board. Schedule board settings provide utilization-related display controls, including showing the booked percentage; board colors also indicate how much a resource is used. Configuring the board view settings provides this built-in visualization.\
\
**Learn more:** [Review resource utilization metrics on the schedule board](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/field-service/schedule-board-utilization) · [Schedule board tab settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/field-service/schedule-board-tab-settings)

questions.question:
You need to implement a solution for the customer service supervisor.  
  
Which two security roles should you assign to the customer service supervisor?  
  
Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
The Omnichannel administrator role provides the privileges to create, edit, and delete workstreams, including an SMS workstream. The Productivity tools administrator role provides the privileges to create, read, write, append, and delete agent scripts and agent-script workflows.\
\
**Learn more:** [Assign roles and enable users in Dynamics 365 Contact Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-au/dynamics365/customer-service/implement/add-users-assign-roles)

questions.question:
You need to add French as a new skill.  
  
Where should you add the language?
questions.explanation:
A language is configured as a skill type by adding it to the **Bookable Resource Characteristic Type** option set. A rating value can subsequently represent an agent’s proficiency for that skill.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up skills, create a rating model, and assign representatives](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/setup-skills-assign-agents)

questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 Customer Service and have recently acquired Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
You need to ensure that an agent cannot see a client’s credit card information during a live chat.  
  
Which action should you take?

options.text: You should configure a business rule.
You should configure a data masking rule.
You should configure a routing rule.

questions.explanation:
A data masking rule identifies sensitive values in conversation messages and replaces them with masked characters. Dynamics 365 Customer Service includes a Credit Card masking rule, and masking can be configured to hide private customer data from agents in live chat.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage data masking rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/data-masking-settings)

questions.question:
You use Dynamics 365 Customer Service and have recently acquired Omnichannel for Customer Service.  
  
You need to ensure that an agent cannot see a client’s credit card information during a live chat.  
  
Which action should you take?

options.text: Ensure that the case has a description.
Provide feedback comments to the Case summary feature in Copilot.
Change the case to resolved and expand the case summary card.

questions.explanation:
Copilot case summaries require sufficient source content. A summary is not generated when the descriptions in the case fields used by Copilot contain fewer than 38 English words, so the case must include a description with enough information for Copilot to summarize.

**Learn more:** [Use Copilot-generated case summaries](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/copilot-use-summary)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are setting up Dynamics 365 Customer Service workspaces.  
  
Users want to use minimal keystrokes and straightforward navigation to open multiple sessions.  
  
You need to configure the simplified navigation experience.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Run the simplified navigation settings code in the browser console window within Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
Enable the appropriate features in the Power Platform admin center of the Dynamics 365 Customer Service environment.
Configure the settings in the Agent Experience area of the Customer Service Hub.
Configure the settings in the administration console.

questions.explanation:
The simplified navigation experience is configured in the **Agent Experience** area of the Customer Service Hub. This workspace capability supports multisession work by making session and tab navigation easier for representatives. Microsoft’s current workspace documentation confirms the multisession navigation model, while the legacy setting referenced here belongs to the earlier Customer Service Hub configuration experience.

**Learn more:** [Get started with Copilot Service workspace](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/implement/csw-overview?tabs=customerserviceadmincenter)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You configured a customer service business unit as the parent of call center, digital response, and escalation business units. Each of these business units has its own queues. Customer service cases are routed to the appropriate parties through those queues. You have not modified any security roles.  
  
You must ensure that a user in the customer service business unit can read queues in both the parent and child business units.  
  
You assign the user the System customizer security role.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
The System Customizer role has user-level access to system entities, including queues; it does not grant the business-unit or Parent:Child Business Unit read scope needed to view queues across the parent and child business units. Dataverse access levels must explicitly provide that wider scope.

**Learn more:** [Create or edit business units - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/create-edit-business-units) · [Security roles in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (on-premises)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/admin/security-roles-privileges?view=op-9-1)

options.text: Set the Regarding column to the Account table.
Set the Regarding column to the Contact table.

questions.explanation:
The Timeline control displays related tasks, appointments, phone calls, emails, notes, and system or user posts on a model-driven form. Timeline activities are shown when their Regarding column is associated with the table being viewed; setting it to the Account table associates the activities with the customer’s company.

**Learn more:** [Set up the timeline control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/set-up-timeline-control) · [Use the model-driven app main form and its components](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/use-main-form-and-components)

questions.question:
You have been assigned to create a phone call activity. You need to ensure that the activity is displayed on the case record timeline.  
  
Which of the following fields should be modified during this process?
questions.explanation:
The **Regarding** field associates a phone call activity with the case record. An activity whose Regarding field is set to a case appears in that case’s activity timeline.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add activities in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/basics/add-phone-call-task-email-appointment-activity-case-record?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
You need to add the confirmation step to cases.  
  
What should you modify?
questions.explanation:
A business process flow defines the guided stages and steps that users follow for a case. Editing the business process flow allows a Confirmation stage or step to be placed before the Resolve stage.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create business process flow in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/customize/create-business-process-flow?view=op-9-1) · [Business process flows overview - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/business-process-flows-overview)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to satisfy the three-day and seven-day timeframes.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Service-level agreement conditions determine which resolution-time KPI applies to each case type, such as phone versus email, and SLA items set the associated business-hour failure durations. Dynamics 365 Customer Service SLAs support resolution-time KPIs and condition-based application to cases.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of service-level agreements](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/overview-service-level-agreements) · [Configure service-level agreements in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-service-level-agreements)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization intends to use Microsoft Power BI to access and analyze data in Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You must configure a Power BI connection to a Dynamics 365 organization named Contoso.  
  
Which service URL should be used?
questions.explanation:
A Power BI connection targets the Dynamics 365 organization’s instance URL. Dynamics 365 Online instance URLs use the organization-specific `https://<organization-name>.crm.dynamics.com` form; therefore, Contoso uses `https://contoso.crm.dynamics.com`. Discovery endpoints locate organizations, while an `Organization.svc` endpoint is a legacy service-specific endpoint rather than the requested organization URL. [Power Query Dynamics 365 Online (legacy) connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/dynamics-365-online)

**Learn more:** [Power Query Dynamics 365 Online (legacy) connector](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-query/connectors/dynamics-365-online) · [Dynamics 365 and Power Platform datacenter regions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/new-datacenter-regions)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company manufactures, installs, and maintains residential water-filtration systems. The company deploys Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
Installation technicians contact support technicians when they run into problems during system installations.  
  
You must create step-by-step documentation for the support technicians.  
  
Which two fields must be included? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Step-by-step guidance that support technicians follow is authored as a knowledge article in Dynamics 365 Customer Service. When creating a knowledge article, the content of the procedure is captured in the Description (body) field, and because articles are versioned per language, the Language field must be set so the article is created and surfaced correctly for the intended audience (choices A and D). Agent script (B) is a separate guided-interaction feature and Owner (C) is an ownership attribute, neither of which is a required content field for the step-by-step documentation itself.

**Learn more:** [Overview of knowledge management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/overview-knowledge-management) · [MB-230 study guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/resources/study-guides/mb-230)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You configured a customer service business unit as the parent of call center, digital response, and escalation business units. Each of these business units has its own queues. Customer service cases are routed to the appropriate parties through the queues. You have not modified any security roles.  
  
You must ensure that a user in the customer service business unit can read queues in both the parent and child business units.  
  
You assign the user the CSR Manager security role.  
  
Does this action meet your objective?
questions.explanation:
Reading queues across a business-unit hierarchy requires Queue Read access at the Parent:Child Business Units (Deep) level, which covers the user’s business unit and subordinate business units. The unmodified CSR Manager role is a local or team-level customer-service management role, so assigning it alone does not grant the required hierarchy-wide queue access.

**Learn more:** [How role-based security can be used to control access to entities](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/security-dev/how-role-based-security-control-access-entities?view=op-9-1) · [Queue entities](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/queue-entities?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service, and you work as a customer service representative.  
  
You have been assigned to identify and remove duplicate cases.  
  
You decide to use parent-child case relationships to accomplish this goal.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
Parent-child case relationships organize related cases for coordinated management, but they do not detect duplicate records or eliminate them. Potential duplicates are identified through duplicate-detection rules, and redundant cases are removed by merging the cases.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage parent and child cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-create-and-manage-parent-and-child-cases) · [Merge cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-merge-cases)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a **Single Line Of Text** column and set its format to **Text Area**.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Text Area format provides a multi-line text box for a text column and supports a configurable maximum text length, but it does not store or upload image and file data through that same control. A rich text editor is needed to support formatted text together with inline images and files.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and edit columns in Dataverse using Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-edit-field-portal) · [Add the rich text editor control to a model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/rich-text-editor-control)

questions.question:
Solution: Create File, Image, and Multiline columns, and use a Formula column to concatenate the data.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Separate File, Image, and Multiline columns require separate data-entry controls. A Dataverse formula column can concatenate strings, but it does not merge file and image content into a single editable control. The rich text editor is applied to a text column and supports inline image and file handling, while the text column can enforce a maximum length.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add the rich text editor control to a model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/rich-text-editor-control) · [Work with Dataverse formula columns](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/formula-columns)

questions.question:
Solution: Create a Single Line of Text column and set its format to Rich Text.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A text column formatted as Rich text uses the rich text editor, which supports formatted text, images, and file attachments in the same editor. Text columns also provide a configurable maximum length; for rich text, that limit includes the stored HTML markup as well as user-entered text.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add the rich text editor control to a model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/rich-text-editor-control) · [Create and edit columns in Dataverse using Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-edit-field-portal)

options.text: You should configure a pre-conversation survey.
You should configure a Teams channel.
You should configure an SMS channel.

questions.explanation:
A pre-conversation survey is the Omnichannel chat feature that displays configured questions to a customer when they access the chat widget to begin a conversation. Customer Voice supports post-conversation surveys rather than gathering responses before chat starts.

**Learn more:** [Configure a preconversation survey](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-pre-chat-survey) · [Configure post-conversation survey using Customer Voice](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-post-conversation-survey)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. This manufacturing company operates several locations and has 10 repair technicians.  
  
The company is implementing scheduling and must ensure that the right repair technicians, with the right tools, are sent to the facility nearest to them.  
  
You need to identify the valid resources.  
  
Which two options are valid resources? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service Service Scheduling supports Equipment and Contact as bookable resource types. Equipment represents schedulable tools or other assets, and Contact is also a supported resource type; Record, Activity, and Case are not bookable-resource types.

**Learn more:** [Create and set up bookable resources](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/resources-service-scheduling)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are customizing an Omnichannel for Customer Service implementation.  
  
A call center wants to enable a chat channel for unauthenticated chats with these requirements:  
  
- Chat must automatically identify a customer for agents.  
- A chat widget must be embedded on a specific domain.  
  
You need to customize the solution to meet the requirements.  
  
Which two options should you select? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A pre-chat survey can collect customer information before an unauthenticated conversation begins and supports automatically identifying customers from preconversation responses. A widget location specifies the website domain on which the chat widget is displayed. Visitor location only detects geographic location, and proactive chat controls automatic chat invitations.

**Learn more:** [Configure a preconversation survey](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-pre-chat-survey) · [Chat widget doesn't load on the portal](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/dynamics-365/customer-service/omnichannel-for-customer-service/chat-widget-not-loading-portal)

questions.question:
Solution: Turn on smart matching.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Smart matching correlates tracked email messages with related records based on similarity between email messages; it does not control Dataverse search indexing. Searchable fields for Dataverse search are defined by the Find columns in the table’s Quick Find view, so enabling smart matching will not enable relevance searches for email addresses.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure Dataverse search for your environment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/configure-relevance-search-organization) · [Manage email tracking settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/settings-email-tracking)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the interactive experience global filter.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Interactive experience global filters control which fields users can apply to interactive dashboard charts, streams, and tiles; they do not configure the Dataverse search index. Dataverse search uses the Find, View, and Filter columns in a table’s Quick Find view, so configuring a global dashboard filter will not make email addresses available for relevance searches.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure Dataverse search for your environment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/configure-relevance-search-organization) · [Customize interactive dashboards that are based on Unified Interface](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-interactive-dashboards-customer-service-hub)

questions.question:
Solution: Enable the customization that includes Knowledge Management.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Knowledge Management enables knowledge-base capabilities and article search, not email-address indexing for global relevance search. Dataverse search uses the Find columns of each table’s Quick Find view to define searchable fields; the email address must be included there for it to be searchable.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure Dataverse search for your environment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/configure-relevance-search-organization) · [Configure knowledge management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-knowledge-management-embedded-knowledge-search)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Omnichannel for Customer Service for a company.  
  
The company wants agents to support customers through both the company portal and its Facebook page.  
  
You need to enable the appropriate channels.  
  
Which two channels should you enable? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Chat provides customer support through a live chat experience, including on a company portal. Facebook is a supported social channel in Dynamics 365 Customer Service, so Social channels must be enabled for conversations through the company’s Facebook page.

**Learn more:** [Overview of channels — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/use/channels) · [Introduction to the chat channel — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-chat-widget)

A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
Telemetry for agent case-resolution time shows that agents take an average of 20 minutes to resolve cases. Analysis finds that resolution time increases because agents frequently must view and update data on the related account.  
  
The company needs a solution that enables agents to enter data on one screen and edit multiple records without opening each record separately.  
  
You need to create the solution.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer is part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add an editable grid of the account on the case form.
Configure the editable grid of the case view to include account details.
Add an editable grid control to the case view.

questions.explanation:
The editable grid control enables inline editing directly in a main grid or form subgrid, avoiding the need to open each record. Applying it to the Case view and adding Account detail columns to that view provides a single-screen worklist where agents can see the account context and update Case records efficiently. Microsoft documents editable grids as supporting inline editing in main grids and subgrids, and views can be configured with the columns needed for the worklist.

**Learn more:** [Make model-driven app views and grids editable using the editable grid control](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/make-grids-lists-editable-custom-control) · [Use editable grids in model-driven apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/model-driven-apps/use-editable-grids)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to assess the underlined segment to determine whether it is accurate.  
  
A customer service manager requires the __Append__ access level to add new entitlement templates for customer service representatives.
questions.explanation:
Creating entitlement templates requires the appropriate Customer Service Manager (or equivalent) permissions. In Dataverse security, **Append** is a privilege for associating records, whereas organization-level configuration records require the **Organization** access level; a Business unit scope is not sufficient for organization-wide entitlement templates.

**Learn more:** [Set up entitlements quickly with templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-entitlements-templates) · [Security concepts for developers (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/security-concepts)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Omnichannel for Customer Service for a company.  
  
The company has these requirements:  
  
- Initial conversations must be routed to Power Virtual Agents chatbots.  
- When a conversation requires escalation, it must be routed to a human agent.  
- The chatbot and human agents must be in the same queue.  
  
You need to finish the implementation to satisfy the requirements.  
  
How must the chatbot capacity compare with the agents’ capacity?

options.text: The chatbot capacity must be the same as the capacity of the agents.
The chatbot capacity must be less than the capacity of the agents.
The chatbot capacity must be higher than the capacity of the agents.

questions.explanation:
In a shared queue, an AI agent or chatbot must have a capacity higher than every human agent so that it receives incoming conversations first. Its capacity is not reduced when it is assigned a work item, while an escalated conversation can be routed to an eligible human agent. [Microsoft Learn: Best practices for configuring AI agents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-best-practices)

**Learn more:** [Best practices for configuring AI agents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-bot-best-practices)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A service representative resolves a customer case by using Dynamics 365 Customer Service. A Customer Voice survey is automatically sent to the customer to gather feedback. The customer completes and submits the survey.  
  
You need to review the response details for the completed survey.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Review the survey invite record details on the case timeline.
Review the survey response record details on the case timeline.
Open the survey response record to view the details in the record.
Open the survey invite record to view the details in the record.

questions.explanation:
After a customer submits a Customer Voice survey, the survey response record is attached to the related case and appears on its timeline. Opening that response record displays the response details in the Dynamics 365 Customer Voice survey response form. Survey invitation records concern the survey delivery rather than the submitted response details.

**Learn more:** [Integrate Dynamics 365 Customer Voice with Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-voice/integrate-cv-cs)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Solution: Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the Source type to **Email**, and then select the queue. Configure the autoresponse settings.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An Email automatic record creation and update rule must include a rule item with a Create Record action for the Case entity and be activated before incoming queue email creates cases. Selecting a queue is required for an Email source, while an automatic response is only sent after a target record has been created; it does not itself configure Case creation. [Microsoft Learn: Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

**Learn more:** [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the Source type to Service activity, then select the queue.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Automatic record creation and update rules that create cases from incoming email must use **Email** as the source type (activity type to monitor). Although a queue is required for an email source type, selecting **Service activity** does not process messages sent to the queue email address.\
\
**Learn more:** [Automatically create or update records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-update-records) · [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure Dynamics 365 to automatically send replies to customers when the record is created.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Automatically sending a response after a record is created does not create a case from an incoming email. Automatic record creation and update rules are required to create case records from incoming emails in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.\
\
**Learn more:** [Automatically create or update records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-update-records)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an automatic record creation and update rule. Set the Source type to Email, then select the queue. Configure conditions for record creation.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An automatic record creation and update rule processes incoming email only after it has rule items defining the conditions and record-creation action, and it must be activated. The configuration must create a Case when the conditions are met; conditions alone do not complete or activate the case-creation process.\
\
**Learn more:** [Automatically create or update records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-update-records)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an automatic record creation and update rule, and set its record type to Email.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
For an email-source automatic record creation and update rule, a queue is required and must be configured for the email address that receives the incoming messages. The rule also needs a Create record action that selects Case as the target record type. Setting the source record type to Email by itself does not create cases from emails sent to the specified address.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

questions.question:
Solution: Create an automatic record creation and update rule, and set its record type to Email.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An automatic record creation and update rule for Email must be associated with the relevant queue, but automatic case creation also requires a rule action that creates a Case record. Configuring the email activity type, queue, and optional automatic-reply template without specifying the Case creation action does not create cases from incoming emails.

**Learn more:** [Automatically create or update records in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/automatically-create-update-records) · [Set up rules to automatically create or update records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-rules-to-automatically-create-or-update-records)

Your company has several business process flows for managing contracts.  
  
You want to define the default process flow.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You sign in to Dynamics 365 Customer Service as a system administrator and try to configure unified record routing across digital messaging channels.  
  
You receive the following error message:  
  
> Some required services need to be installed before unified routing can be turned on. Please contact Microsoft Support.  
  
You need to enable unified record routing and route records.  
  
Which three steps must you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Provision unified routing for Customer Service only.
Set up users as bookable resources.

questions.explanation:
Omnichannel for Customer Service supplies the required services for digital messaging; its absence produces the stated unified-routing enablement error. Record routing depends on queue-enabled entities, and the users who can receive automatically routed work must be configured as bookable resources. Microsoft documents that record routing requires a routing-enabled record and bookable-resource users, while the unified-routing setup process includes configuring users as bookable resources.

**Learn more:** [Manage unified routing for Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/provision-unified-routing) · [Set up unified routing for records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-record-routing)

questions.question:
Proposed solution: Create a time group with a preference setting of one hour.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Time groups present availability in defined blocks but preserve the original start and arrival times from a resource’s schedule. They do not control the duration or starting point of successive booking slots. Intervals control those slots; a one-hour interval is needed to prevent additional work from starting within the same one-hour block.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set fulfillment preferences to determine how results are displayed in Universal Resource Scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/common-scheduler/fulfillment-preferences)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure the working-hours calendar to permit one-hour resource booking blocks.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Working hours define when a resource is available, whereas a fulfillment preference interval determines the duration between available scheduling slots and the start point for subsequent bookings. A one-hour interval is required to enforce hourly booking boundaries; configuring only the working-hours calendar does not prevent a subsequent job from being scheduled within a partially used one-hour block.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set fulfillment preferences to determine how results are displayed in Universal Resource Scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/common-scheduler/fulfillment-preferences) · [Set up bookable resources - Dynamics 365 Field Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/field-service/set-up-bookable-resources)

questions.question:
Proposed solution: Change the scheduler time resolution to one hour.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Fulfillment-preference intervals define the duration of available time slots and the start points for subsequent bookings. A one-hour interval in the fulfillment preference is required to constrain booking starts to one-hour blocks; changing the scheduler time resolution alone does not establish those fulfillment-preference intervals or prevent another booking within a block.\
\
**Learn more:** [Define intervals and time groups with fulfillment preferences - Dynamics 365 Field Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/field-service/set-up-time-groups)

questions.question:
Proposed solution: Create a fulfillment record and set the interval to one hour.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A fulfillment preference interval determines the duration of each available time slot and the starting point for subsequent bookings. Setting the interval to one hour aligns bookings to hourly blocks, so an engineer cannot begin another job within a block already occupied by any portion of a job.\
\
**Learn more:** [Define intervals and time groups with fulfillment preferences - Dynamics 365 Field Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/field-service/set-up-time-groups)

The status reason for a Cancelled case status will be __Researching__.
questions.explanation:
For Dynamics 365 Case records, **Researching** is a status reason for an Active case. **Merged** is a valid status reason for a Cancelled case. [Microsoft Learn: Case (Incident) table/entity reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/incident)\
\

questions.question:
You are responsible for designing surveys through Voice of the Customer (VoC).  
  
You need to ensure that the design can show or hide questions based on the answer selected.  
  
You include client-side routing in the design.  
  
Does this action achieve the objective?
questions.explanation:
Client-side routing in Voice of the Customer supports conditional survey behavior during completion, including showing or hiding questions according to a respondent’s selected answer. Microsoft’s current Customer Voice branching rules provide the equivalent conditional show/hide behavior.\

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Omnichannel for Customer Service for a company.  
  
The company has established dedicated teams to manage inquiries from different social platforms. Each team member specializes in a particular company product line. However, team members must be able to pick up any inquiry that enters their team.  
  
You need to configure the system.  
  
Which two components should you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Work item triggers initiate routing for incoming work items, and routing rules use the work-item context to send each social-channel inquiry to the appropriate team queue. Queue membership and the queue assignment method then allow any eligible member of that team to receive the inquiry; agent affinity is intended to preserve assignment to a previously involved representative instead.

**Learn more:** [Configure route-to-queue rules for a workstream](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/configure-route-to-queue-rules) · [Create and manage queues for unified routing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/queues-omnichannel)

questions.question:
You must ensure that claim disputes comply with the defined case life cycle.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Status Reason Transitions define the permitted next status-reason values for a Case. Restricting these transitions enforces the required case-life-cycle sequence and prevents unsupported status changes.\
\
**Learn more:** [Define status reason transitions in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/customize/define-status-reason-transitions?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
You must ensure that claim disputes comply with the defined case life cycle.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: From the supervisor configuration, add all users to the intraday insights dashboard.
From the agent configuration, promote the users to supervisors.
From universal service desk, enable all dashboards.
From the supervisor configuration, add the required users.
From Power BI, share the dashboard with the entire organization.

questions.explanation:
Access to Omnichannel analytics dashboards is controlled through the appropriate Omnichannel roles and configuration. Adding the required managers in the supervisor configuration grants the intended users access without unnecessarily granting organization-wide dashboard access or changing unrelated users’ roles.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service administrator.  
  
Your company offers standard support contracts that include a total of 20 hours of email support. All 20 hours are exclusively for email support. Phone support is available as a premium service in allotments of 10 incidents.  
  
You need to configure an entitlement template for the standard support.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Set up an entitlement record for each account.Set the value of the Total Terms field for the entitlement to 20.Do not configure an entitlement channel.

Set the value of the Total Terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the entitlement channel option to Email. Set the value of the Total Terms field to 0.Add the Phone option.Set the value of the Total Terms field to 10.
Set the value of the Total Terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the value of the entitlement channel option to Email.

Set the value of the Total Terms field for an entitlement to 20. Set the entitlement channel option to Email.Set the value of the Total Terms field to 10. Add the Phone option. Set the value of the Total Terms field to 10.

questions.explanation:
An entitlement template defines the overall support allocation, while entitlement channels define the support channels customers may use. The standard offering has a total allocation of 20 hours and is limited to the Email channel; adding Phone would incorrectly grant premium phone support. Microsoft documents that entitlement channels define the channels customers are entitled to use and can track support terms by channel separately.

**Learn more:** [Set up entitlements quickly with templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-entitlements-templates)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service. A case in the queue is routed to you.  
  
You will be going on vacation and need to assign the case to someone else. What should you do?

options.text: Route the case to another queue.

questions.explanation: Releasing a routed case returns it to the queue so another available agent can pick it up and work it. Sharing only grants access, routing changes the queue destination, and escalation does not transfer responsibility for the case.

questions.question:

The customer plans to use service scheduling.  
  
You need to install service scheduling.  
  
What should you use to install service scheduling?
questions.explanation:
For an environment where the Core Service Scheduling solution is not installed, Dynamics 365 Service Scheduling is installed from the Power Platform admin center under Dynamics 365 apps.\

questions.question:
Solution:  
  
- Configure each user queue as private.  
- Configure the level1 and level2 queues as public, and add the applicable members.  
- Configure the support queue as private.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A private Dynamics 365 queue can be viewed and worked only by its members. Making the support queue private without adding the users as members means they cannot work from that queue, so the required access is not met.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases) · [Queue tables (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/queue-entities)

questions.question:
Solution:  
  
- Configure each user queue as private.  
- Configure the level1 and level2 queues as public, and add the applicable members.  
- Configure the support queue as public.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A private user queue is visible only to its user, satisfying the requirement that users cannot access or view one another’s queues. A public support queue is visible to all users, allowing them to work from that queue. Public and private queue behavior is documented by Microsoft Learn.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases) · [Queue entities (Developer Guide for Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/queue-entities?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
Proposed solution:  
  
- Configure every user queue as public.  
- Configure the level1 and level2 queues as public, and add the appropriate members.  
- Configure the support queue as public.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Public queues are visible to everyone in the organization who has read privileges for the queue entity, whereas private queues restrict visibility to their members. Making every user queue public therefore violates the requirement that users cannot access or view one another’s queues. [Microsoft Learn: Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.question:
Solution:  
  
- Configure each user queue as private.  
- Configure the level1 and level2 queues as private, and add the relevant members.  
- Configure the support queue as public.  
  
Does this solution satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, a private queue is visible only to its members; user queues are private for the individual user. Private level1 and level2 queues can therefore be restricted to the applicable members, while a public support queue lets all authorized users view and work its items.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases) · [Queue tables (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/queue-entities)

You need to look up answers for customer claims.  
  
Which search type should you use?
questions.explanation:
In Dynamics 365 Customer Service, answers to customer issues (claims) come from knowledge articles and other resources surfaced on the case's Related area. The Related tab exposes the commonly associated entities such as Knowledge Base Records, activities, and connections, which is where an agent looks up answers to a customer's claim (choice C). Quick Find (B) is a generic categorized record search, Timeline (A) shows the case's activity history, Detail (D) is not a claim-answer search, and Case Relationships (E) is oriented toward linking/merging similar cases rather than looking up answers.

**Learn more:** [Search knowledge articles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/search-knowledge-articles-csh) · [Overview of knowledge management](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/overview-knowledge-management)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are customizing a Dynamics 365 Customer Service implementation for a company.

options.text: Copy the code snippet from the workstream form and paste it in the web template of the portal homepage.

questions.question:
A company has a Customer Service deployment.  
  
The company intends to implement macros.  
  
You need to create and configure a macro.  
  
Which connector should be used?
questions.explanation:
The Session connector provides session-related actions for Customer Service macros, including obtaining tab IDs, refreshing or focusing tabs, opening tab templates, and refreshing session context. Microsoft documents it as a connector for creating Customer Service macros.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure macros to improve representative productivity](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros) · [Use session connector macros](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/macros-session-action)

You need to create and configure a macro.  
  
Which connector should be used?
questions.explanation:
Agent scripts must be associated with a session template so they load for representatives based on the type of session they open in the workspace app. A workstream can be associated with that session template, but it is not the record that directly associates the script.

**Learn more:** [Guide representatives with scripts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/agent-scripts) · [Manage session templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/session-templates)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service and plans to enable in-app notifications to increase agent productivity.  
  
Agents must receive a notification 15 minutes before any scheduled customer calls. Agents must be able to dismiss the notification if necessary.  
  
You need to enable the notification.  
  
Which notification type should be used?
questions.explanation:
A toast notification provides a timely in-app reminder without requiring the agent to take an action. In model-driven apps, notifications can be displayed as toasts and remain accessible in the notification center until the recipient dismisses them or they expire.

**Learn more:** [Send in-app notifications within model-driven apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/model-driven-apps/clientapi/send-in-app-notifications) · [In-app notifications in model-driven apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/notifications)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as an administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service implementation.  
  
Your company uses several business process flows to manage contracts.  
  
You need to specify the default process flow.  
  
You configure the stages in the business process flows.  
  
Does this action accomplish the objective?
questions.explanation:
Configuring stages changes the content of a business process flow, not the default flow selection. The default active flow is determined by the business process flow order; the first applicable active flow in that order is selected.

questions.question:
You are a customer service manager who uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service.  
  
You need to limit support to products that a customer has purchased.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add the product to the account
Add the products to the case
Add the products to the customer's entitlement
Add the products to the customer

questions.explanation:
Entitlements define the support for which a customer is eligible. Associating specific products with a customer’s entitlement makes the entitlement apply only to those products; without product associations, it applies to all products.\
\

You work as a system administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You have been assigned to ensure that customer service representatives can manually add service-level agreements (SLAs) to a record.  
  
You grant the customer service representatives the required permissions.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation:

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Dynamics 365 Customer Service system administrator.  
  
You cannot add 20 hours of phone time to the Entitlement channel.  
  
You need to identify why you are unable to add the hours.  
  
What are three possible reasons? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The Entitlement start date is in the future.
The Entitlement is in draft mode.
The Entitlement is in active mode.
The Entitlement expiration date has passed.

questions.explanation:
Entitlement channel terms can be created, modified, or deleted only when the associated entitlement is in the Draft state. A canceled entitlement, an active entitlement, and an entitlement whose expiration date has passed are not Draft, so phone-channel hours cannot be added. A future start date alone does not prevent modification because the entitlement can remain in Draft state until it is activated.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer) · [Web service error codes (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/reference/web-service-error-codes)

questions.question:
A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
The schedule displays work intervals of 45 minutes. These intervals leave customer service representatives with too much free time during their working hours. The company wants to change the intervals to 30 minutes.

What should you configure?

options.text: Schedule with travel time and distance

questions.explanation:
Fulfillment preferences define the duration of time slots presented by the schedule assistant and the starting point for later bookings. Setting the interval to 30 minutes makes scheduling use 30-minute availability slots.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set fulfillment preferences to determine how results are displayed in Universal Resource Scheduling](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/common-scheduler/fulfillment-preferences)

A fitness company operates several locations.  
  
The company deploys Dynamics 365 Customer Service and uses it to schedule personal-trainer sessions with customers.  
  
Customers report these issues:  
  
- Customers are assigned personal trainers who do not reside at the customer's location.  
- Customers are assigned personal trainers during the trainers’ non-working hours.  
  
You need to resolve the issues.  
  
Which two settings should you configure? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Facility resources represent physical locations used to perform services and can be included in service-scheduling resource requirements, allowing appointments to be constrained to the customer’s location. Work Hours define when a bookable resource is available to be scheduled, preventing trainer sessions from being assigned outside the trainer’s working time.

**Learn more:** [Create and set up bookable resources](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/resources-service-scheduling) · [Set work hours to define availability](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/set-work-hours-resource)

questions.question:
Determine whether the underlined segment is correct.  
  
_Routing rules_ must be used to automate the process of adding cases to a queue.
questions.explanation: Routing rules in Dynamics 365 Customer Service automate the routing of cases to queues or users, so the statement is accurate.

questions.question:
You are responsible for creating surveys by using Voice of the Customer (VoC).  
  
You want to ensure that clients who currently receive surveys can unsubscribe if they no longer wish to receive them.  
  
You add an unsubscribe link to the email message.  
  
Does this action meet your objective?
questions.explanation:
Customer Voice email messages can include an unsubscribe link that allows a respondent to unsubscribe from the survey. Therefore, adding the link enables current survey recipients to opt out.\
\
**Learn more:** [Send a survey by using email](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-nz/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-email)

questions.question:
You are responsible for designing surveys through Voice of the Customer (VoC).  
  
You want to ensure the design lets questions be shown or hidden based on the answer selected.  
  
You include the Piping feature in the design.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
Piping inserts or reuses a respondent’s earlier answer in survey content; it does not conditionally show or hide questions. Conditional question visibility based on a response is provided by branching rules, which include Show and Hide actions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a branching rule for a survey](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-voice/create-branching-rule)
