options.text: The state of the case will change to Resolved and the state will change to Canceled.
The state of the case will change to Merged and the state will change to Merged.
The state of the case will change to Deleted and the state will change to Resolved.
The state of the case will change to Canceled and the state will change to Merged.

questions.explanation:
When a case is merged into another case, Dynamics 365 Customer Service changes the merged case’s state to **Canceled** and its status reason to **Merged**.

**Learn more:** [Merge cases | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/customer-service-hub-user-guide-merge-cases) · [Case (Incident) table/entity reference | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/developer/reference/entities/incident)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a system administrator for Dynamics 365 Customer Service.  
  
All child cases must inherit the product, customer name, case title, and case type from their parent case. Parent cases must not be closed until every child case is closed.  
  
You need to configure cases.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Set the closure preference setting to Don’t allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed.
On the case entity, update the Parent case-Child case 1:N relationship field mapping to include all the required fields that should map from the parent case.

Validate that customer and case title fields have not been removed as fields that child cases inherit from parent cases. Add product and case-type fields to the list. The closure preference setting does not need to be changed. This is default behavior.

Validate that customer and case title fields have not been removed as fields that child cases inherit from parent cases. Add product and case type fields to the list. Set the closure preference setting to Don’t allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service parent-child case settings let administrators choose which case attributes a child inherits. Case Title and Customer are mandatory inherited attributes, and Product and Case Type must be added to the selected attributes. The closure preference must be set to **Don’t allow parent case closure until all child cases are closed** to prevent closure while active child cases exist.

**Learn more:** [Define parent and child case settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-settings-parent-child-cases) · [Incident (case) hierarchies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/incident-case-hierarchies?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are deploying Dynamics 365 Customer Service for a company in India. The company has strict data-residency guidelines requiring that data not leave the geographic boundary.  
  
Users need a solution that lets them easily find and receive suggestions for resolving cases.  
  
You need to configure a feature that satisfies these requirements.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
The Knowledge Base Search control is a native Dynamics 365 Customer Service feature that enables representatives to find knowledge articles from case records and supports automatic suggestions based on configured case fields. Its configuration is performed in Microsoft Dataverse, while Dynamics 365 and Power Platform store customer data at rest in the customer-selected geographic location. Case Management Agent is a generative-AI capability that requires enabling movement of data across regions for Copilots and generative AI features, so it is unsuitable where data must remain within the geographic boundary.

**Learn more:** [Add the Knowledge Base Search control to Dynamics 365 Customer Service forms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-knowledge-base-search-control-forms) · [Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform data residency documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/get-started/availability)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Dynamics 365 Customer Service workspaces.  
  
As a customer service representative, you must be able to view and work on multiple work items simultaneously.  
  
You need to move between the work items that are active in the workspace.  
  
Which two methods can you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Customer Service workspace organizes concurrent work as sessions. Representatives can navigate among active work items by selecting the relevant session tab or selecting the session from the session pane list. Microsoft documents that the workspace supports multiple simultaneous sessions and that the left panel displays the session list.

**Learn more:** [Overview of the Copilot Service workspace application for Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/implement/csw-overview) · [Manage application tab templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/application-tab-templates)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dynamics 365 Customer Service together with IoT devices.  
  
A user whose permissions allow use of the Customer Service app tries to connect an IoT device. The user receives an error stating that they are not authorized to add the device.  
  
You need to ensure that the user can add the device. You must apply the principle of least-privileged access.  
  
Which two roles should be assigned to the user? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
For Connected Customer Service users who must register devices and perform IoT Hub operations, Microsoft recommends assigning the IoT Administrator and IoT Endpoint User security roles. These roles provide the required Connected Customer Service permissions without granting broader Azure IoT Hub data-plane or device-registry permissions.

**Learn more:** [Security roles for Connected Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-security-roles)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a system administrator for Dynamics 365 Customer Service. On the default account form, you create an escalation column with Yes/No choices.  
  
The main account form must include an escalation-path column. This column must be hidden when the escalation column is set to No. When the escalation column is set to Yes, the escalation-path column must be displayed and required.  
  
You need to configure the form.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A business rule can apply conditional form logic in a model-driven app: it can show or hide a column and dynamically set its requirement level. Configure it to hide the escalation-path column when escalation is No, and to show and require that column when escalation is Yes.

**Learn more:** [Create a business rule in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-create-business-rule)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You configure a default entitlement for a customer.  
  
You must ensure that the default entitlement is automatically linked to a case.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Update the customer, contact, or product field on an existing case.
Update the description field on an existing case.
Add an activity to an existing case.

questions.explanation:
A customer’s default entitlement can be automatically applied when a case is created. For an existing case, automatic default-entitlement application is triggered only by updating its customer, contact, or product information; updates to unrelated fields or activities do not trigger it.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer) · [Entitlement entities (Developer Guide for Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/entitlement-entities?view=op-9-1)

questions.question:
A company shuts down operations for nine business days every year.  
  
You need to configure the system to reflect this business closure while minimizing the number of records you must create.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: nine customer service calendar records of a one-day duration
two holiday calendar records of a seven-day duration
three holiday schedule records of a three-day duration
one business closure record of a nine-day duration

questions.explanation:
A business closure prevents resource scheduling during organization-wide holidays or other nonworking periods. It can be configured with a start date and a duration, so one nine-day business-closure record represents the full annual shutdown with the minimum number of records.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set when your business is closed (Customer Service app)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/set-when-business-closed-cs-app)

questions.question:
A company shuts down operations for nine business days every year.  
  
You need to configure the system to reflect this business closure while minimizing the number of records you must create.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: Set the Communication panel mode to Docked.
Set the Communication panel mode to Minimized.
Use the Case entity session template.

questions.explanation:
A Chat session template is designed for incoming customer conversations, whereas an entity-routing case session hides the communication panel. Setting the communication panel mode to Docked displays it in its expanded state so representatives can exchange messages with customers.

**Learn more:** [Manage session templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/session-templates) · [Manage session templates in Dynamics 365 Channel Integration Framework 2.0](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/channel-integration-framework/v2/administer/session-templates-cif)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service, and you work as a customer service manager.  
  
You need to ensure that a client receives support only for products they have purchased.  
  
To which of the following should you add the products?  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
An entitlement defines the support a customer is eligible to receive. Associating products with a customer's entitlement restricts that entitlement to those specific products; without associated products, the entitlement applies to all products.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
You administer a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service environment and create and activate a routing rule.  
  
You need to change the routing rule so that it targets a queue rather than a user. You navigate to routing rule sets.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Use Lookup to specify the Add to queue value.
Select Edit to the command bar.
Toggle the radio button for Route from user/team to queue.

questions.explanation:
An active basic routing ruleset must be deactivated before it can be edited. After deactivation, its rule item can be changed to route to a queue and the ruleset can be activated again.\
\
**Learn more:** [Automatically route cases using basic routing rulesets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-rules-automatically-route-cases)

questions.question:
You administer a Dynamics 365 for Customer Service environment and create and activate a routing rule.  
  
You need to change the routing rule so that it targets a queue rather than a user. You navigate to routing rule sets.  
  
What should you do first?
questions.explanation:
Business process flow steps configure the activities and fields within a flow, not the default flow selection. The default applicable business process flow is determined by its process-flow order, after applicable security-role and app-context filtering.

questions.explanation:
Automatic work distribution must be enabled to use a queue for unified routing and automated assignment. Mailbox settings and record creation/update rules are unrelated to the required Omnichannel work-distribution configuration.

Which two search features are available? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.

You use Dynamics 365 Customer Service to create and activate entitlements.  
  
Customer service representatives report that an entitlement has a status of **Waiting** and cannot use it. You must ensure that customer service representatives can use the entitlement.  
  
You need to identify the entitlement issue.  
  
What is causing the issue?

options.text: The Products or Contact field values have not been configured before activation.
The start date of the entitlement is in the future.
The entitlement has expired and is awaiting renewal.
The end date of the entitlement has been incorrectly configured to a date that has already passed.

questions.explanation:
An entitlement whose validity period has not started is assigned the Waiting status after activation. It automatically changes to Active on its start date, so a future start date prevents representatives from using it until then.

**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service, and you are employed as a customer service representative.  
  
You have been assigned to detect and remove duplicate cases.  
  
You decide to use business rules to accomplish this goal.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?
questions.explanation:
Business rules enforce conditional logic on records but do not identify or remove duplicate cases. Dynamics 365 duplicate detection rules and duplicate-detection jobs are used to find potential duplicate records; removal requires a separate record-management action.\
\
**Learn more:** [Detect duplicate data so you can fix or remove it](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/detect-duplicate-data) · [Run bulk system jobs to detect duplicate records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/run-bulk-system-jobs-detect-duplicate-records)

questions.question:
Your company uses Dynamics 365 for Customer Service, and you are employed as a customer service representative.  
  
You have been assigned to detect and remove duplicate cases.  
  
You decide to use business rules to accomplish this goal.  
  
Does this action achieve your objective?

options.text: Associate the device with a customer account.
Associate the device with a service level agreement (SLA).
Add the device to Azure IoT Hub.
Add the device to Azure IoT Central.

questions.explanation:
Connected Customer Service receives telemetry and IoT alerts from registered devices through Azure IoT Hub. The device must also be associated with its customer account so incoming alerts are connected to the applicable customer and can support service actions. An SLA defines service commitments, not the device-alert connection.

**Learn more:** [Installation and setup of Connected Customer Service with Azure IoT Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-installation-setup) · [Authorize API connections between Customer Service and Azure IoT Hub](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/cs-iot-authorize-api-connection)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to turn on relevance search for the custom entity.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add Quick Find to the case form.
Add custom entities to Configure Relevance Search in Customizations and Entities.
Add Knowledge Base Search control to the forms case.
Enable Relevance Search in System Settings.

questions.explanation:
Relevance search requires both organization-level enablement and inclusion of the custom entity in the search index. Custom entities must be selected in the relevance-search configuration to be searchable; configuring Quick Find or adding a Knowledge Base Search control does not enable relevance search for the entity.

**Learn more:** [Configure Dataverse search for your environment](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/configure-relevance-search-organization) · [Configure relevance search for transcripts](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/relevance-search-chat-transcript)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to add SLA timers to the Case form.  
  
Which two options must you configure? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create Quick View Form in SLA KPI Instance entity.
Create field in case entity with lookup to SLA KPI Instance.
Create Quick View Form in Case entity with reference to the SLA KPI Instance entity.
Insert subgrid from the SLA KPI Instance entity into the Case Main form.

questions.explanation:
Enhanced SLA timer data is stored in SLA KPI Instance records. The Case entity requires a lookup field to the SLA KPI Instance entity, and a Quick View Form must be created on the SLA KPI Instance entity to host and display the timer on the Case form.

**Learn more:** [Add a timer in forms to track time against enhanced SLAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-timer-forms-track-time-against-enhanced-sla)

questions.question:
You need to ensure that users can search the knowledge base from a case record.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Add Knowledge Base Search control to the dashboard.
Check Knowledge Management from the case entity in the solution.
Insert the Knowledge Base Search control on the form.
Select the Knowledge Base Search control from the entity.
Add the Quick Find option to the views.

questions.explanation:
Knowledge management must be enabled on the Case entity, and the Knowledge Base Search control must be added to the case form. This makes knowledge articles searchable directly from a case record.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add the Knowledge Base Search control to Dynamics 365 Customer Service forms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-knowledge-base-search-control-forms)

questions.question:
You need to create a queue for cases.  
  
Which type of queue should you create?
questions.explanation:
A private queue limits visibility of its work items to the queue’s members, which supports the requirement to restrict each service- and phone-type support group to the team members responsible for it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and manage basic queues for cases](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/set-up-queues-manage-activities-cases)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system to send a manager an email about SLAs in accordance with the requirements.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
An SLA item’s Failure Action runs when the SLA becomes non-compliant (is missed), so it can send the required email notification to support managers. A warning action occurs before the failure threshold is reached.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure service-level agreements in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-service-level-agreements) · [Apply SLAs in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas?tabs=customerserviceadmincenter)

questions.question:
You must implement service-level agreements.  
  
Which agreement type should you implement?
questions.explanation:
Enhanced SLAs support placing cases on hold, automatically pausing and resuming SLA time calculations, and tracking SLA KPIs through SLA KPI Instance records. They support the required case-form timers and KPI visibility while accommodating cases held because of related-contract issues.\
\
**Learn more:** [Enhanced service level agreements (SLAs)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/admin/enhanced-service-level-agreements?view=op-9-1) · [Apply SLAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas?tabs=customerserviceadmincenter)

questions.question:
You must implement service-level agreements.  
  
Which agreement type should you implement?

options.text: Use an existing customer SLA and change the conditions after assigning the SLA to the customer record.
Create a new SLA for each case that does not have a customer SLA.
Go into the SLA configuration and assign it to a customer.
Automatically apply SLAs to records based on business logic.

questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service can apply SLAs automatically according to business logic, including workflows or Power Automate flows, and users can manually apply an SLA by selecting it in the record’s SLA field. These methods enable SLA assignment to records when a customer does not already have an SLA.

**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas?tabs=customerserviceadmincenter)

questions.question:
You need to configure the system so that an email is sent to a manager about the SLAs, in accordance with the requirements.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
An SLA that is missed enters the Non-compliant state. The **Is non-compliant action** runs when the SLA fails and can send the required email notification to support managers.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure service-level agreements in Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/define-service-level-agreements)

questions.question:
You are responsible for creating surveys using Voice of the Customer (VoC).  
  
You want to ensure that clients who currently receive surveys can unsubscribe when they no longer wish to receive them.  
  
You add an **Unsubscribe** check box after each question.  
  
Does this action accomplish your objective?
questions.explanation:
An unsubscribe check box within survey questions does not enroll a recipient in VoC’s opt-out process for future survey invitations. Unsubscription is provided through the configured unsubscribe mechanism, such as an unsubscribe link in the survey invitation email.\
\
**Learn more:** [Send a survey by using email — Dynamics 365 Customer Voice](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-nz/dynamics365/customer-voice/send-survey-email)

questions.question:
A customer’s entitlement cannot be assigned to a case.  
  
You need to identify the cause of the customer’s issue.  
  
What are two possible reasons for this issue? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: The entitlement is in waiting status
The entitlement is set as the default

questions.explanation:
Only active entitlements for the customer are available in a case’s Entitlement lookup. Waiting entitlements have not reached their start date, and expired entitlements have passed their end date, so neither can be assigned to the case.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create entitlements to define support terms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-entitlement-define-support-terms-customer)

questions.question:

You need to identify the cause of the customer’s issue.

options.text: Create a new work stream for each channel.
Add the new channel to the existing work stream.

questions.explanation:
A workstream is the container that configures how channel work items are enriched, routed, and assigned. Facebook and Twitter require their own social-channel configurations and associated workstreams so that their conversations can be routed to the appropriate new-product agents. Resource characteristics and routing rules only influence routing; they do not provision a social channel.

**Learn more:** [Create and manage workstreams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/create-workstreams) · [Deploy social messaging channels in Omnichannel for Dynamics 365 Customer Service](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/training/modules/social-channels/)

questions.question:
You work as a system administrator for your company’s Dynamics 365 for Customer Service implementation.  
  
You must ensure that customer service representatives can manually add service-level agreements (SLAs) to a record.  
  
You add the SLA field to the entity form.  
  
Does this action accomplish the objective?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 Customer Service applies an SLA manually when a user selects it in the SLA field. Because the SLA field is not included on entity forms by default, adding it to the form provides the control needed for representatives to manually apply an SLA.\
\
**Learn more:** [Apply SLAs — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/apply-slas)
